title: Senior Lead Software Developer (Remote, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

This is a high-accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for customers, partners, and the industry. . The successful candidate will take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI-ready connectivity.
Lumen is seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Lead Software Developer, AI Developer Enablement to help shape the next chapter of AI-assisted software engineering across the organization. This role will define, build, and scale reusable AI capabilities that accelerate developer productivity, reduce friction in everyday engineering work, and transform practical AI workflows into high-impact accelerators for teams across the enterprise.
The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern software development, AI-assisted engineering workflows, developer tooling, automation, APIs, cloud platforms, and enterprise engineering practices. This individual will work closely with engineering, platform, DevSecOps, security, product, and AI teams to translate developer pain points into secure, scalable tools, skills, agents, and patterns that teams are eager to adopt.
As the Senior Lead Software Developer, AI Developer Enablement, the candidate will play a visible role in helping engineers write, test, review, troubleshoot, document, and deliver software with greater speed and confidence. This is a builder role for an individual who enjoys progressing from bold ideas and working prototypes to production-ready enablement capabilities that make AI useful in the daily flow of software delivery.
The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of generative AI principles, agentic AI workflows, prompt design, code generation, knowledge retrieval, software delivery practices, responsible AI, and secure enterprise adoption patterns. This role will help make AI enablement practical, measurable, and transformational for developers across Lumen.

Location

This is a work from home position within the US.

The Main Responsibilities

AI-Assisted Development Enablement
  • Design and implement AI-enabled developer workflows for code generation, reviews, debugging, testing, documentation, research, incident triage, and platform navigation. Establish scalable, secure, and repeatable patterns for AI adoption across engineering teams.
  • Develop reusable prompts, agents, integrations, and workflow accelerators that improve developer productivity while aligning with architecture, security, governance, and operational standards.
Developer Productivity & Experience
  • Identify development friction and translate it into high-impact AI solutions. Partner with engineering teams to reduce toil, accelerate delivery, improve onboarding, and enhance the developer experience from ideation through production.
  • Define adoption metrics, feedback loops, and success measures to demonstrate improvements in quality, delivery speed, developer confidence, and overall performance.
Reusable AI Capabilities & Patterns
  • Build and scale shared AI capabilities, reference architectures, prompt libraries, templates, and playbooks that teams can adopt quickly and consistently.
  • Partner with platform, architecture, and security teams to ensure AI solutions are maintainable, discoverable, observable, governed, and aligned with responsible AI practices.
Technical Knowledge & AI-Driven Support
  • Improve access to engineering knowledge through AI-powered search, summarization, technical Q&A, documentation generation, and context-aware support.
  • Transform tribal knowledge, coding standards, platform guidance, and operational playbooks into scalable AI-assisted experiences.
AI Adoption & Community Enablement
  • Drive AI adoption through demos, training, office hours, onboarding resources, reusable examples, and engineering community engagement.
  • Coach developers and technical leaders on practical AI usage, safe experimentation, measurable outcomes, and responsible engineering practices.
Technical Delivery & Project Execution
  • Lead AI enablement initiatives from discovery through production. Define plans, milestones, dependencies, user validation, and production readiness.
  • Identify and mitigate risks related to security, data access, hallucinations, quality, compliance, integrations, user experience, and operational support.
Measurement & Continuous Improvement
  • Measure AI impact through adoption, usage, cycle time reduction, automation, developer satisfaction, and quality improvements.
  • Use data and feedback to refine AI enablement strategies, retire low-value initiatives, and scale high-impact capabilities.
Leadership & Technical Influence
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship for AI developer enablement. Foster innovation, accountability, collaboration, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Guide teams on architecture, prompt engineering, agent workflows, integration patterns, responsible AI, and safe implementation of AI-powered developer solutions.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree or equivalent practical experience preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in software development, platform engineering, developer productivity, AI enablement, automation, or related technical disciplines.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting modern software solutions, developer tools, APIs, integrations, automation frameworks, or internal platforms.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows, coding assistants, generative AI capabilities, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, or applied AI solutions for engineering teams.
  • Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, code quality, testing, documentation, secure coding, CI/CD, operational reliability, and production support practices.
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous developer needs into practical, secure, scalable, and reusable technical solutions.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams including engineering, platform, security, product, architecture, operations, and business stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, demonstrate AI-enabled workflows, influence adoption, and create clear enablement materials.
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI, data protection, security considerations, governance, and risk management for enterprise AI adoption.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, lead technical initiatives, and drive measurable improvements in developer productivity and engineering outcomes.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with LLM-based developer tools, AI coding assistants, agent frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, tool calling, or workflow orchestration.

description:
A Clinical Research Assistant assists with the conduct of clinical research-related activities, including but
not limited to patient recruitment and enrollment, collecting patient information, completing case report
forms, and data entry. This position typically reports to the Principal Investigator, Clinical Research
Manager, or Clinical Research Coordinator. This job is a pre-entry position for the Clinical Research
Coordinator career path. Within its specialized support duties, it receives moderate supervision. Handles
basic issues and problems and refers more complex issues to higher-level staff. The assignments are
semi-routine in nature, including collecting and entering data and working with the study coordinator to
ensure their accuracy and integrity, in strict adherence to study protocols. Requires knowledge and
experience with basic computer skills and web-based applications.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship. This position is Grant-Funded.

Investigator, Sub-Investigator, and/or research team.

participant for each visit according to research protocol.
• Assists with the implementation of procedures and activities of assigned study protocols.
• Participates in coordinating, preparing, and conducting site monitoring visits, audits, and
inspections.
• Collects vitals and assists study coordinator with patient visits at the site.
• Collects study specimens according to the protocol which may include phlebotomy, processing,
and preparation for shipping.
• Performs data entry for clinical trials.
• Assists with site quality assurance and tracks regulatory submissions.

title: Job i Portugal med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 3. september - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Dansktalende Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi.

Opstart den 3. september - Med firmabolig. Vi mangler 3 medarbejdere, så du kan starte alene eller sammen med en af dine venner.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger tekniske supportere til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som Kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN.

To see what it’s like to work at CNN, follow @WBDLife on Instagram and X!

CNN Growth


Come join our team


The CNN Growth team is hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help design, build, and evolve the core systems and experiences that support audience growth, engagement, and monetization across CNN’s digital platforms.
This role is ideal for a senior individual contributor who thrives on solving complex technical problems, leading by example, and partnering closely with engineering managers, product, design, data, and vendors to deliver high impact, consumer facing software at scale.


What you will do


As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader on a newly forming team. You will stay deeply hands on while helping set technical direction, raise engineering standards, and guide architectural decisions across the team.
You will work across the stack to design scalable systems, influence technical approaches, and ensure high quality delivery. You will collaborate closely with your engineering manager and peers to unblock teams, reduce risk, and drive clarity in ambiguous problem spaces.
You will also play a key role in evaluating third party solutions, integrating vendor platforms, and helping the team make sound build vs buy decisions that balance speed, quality, and long term maintainability.


The daily

  • Design, build, and maintain production systems and user facing applications
  • Lead technical design and architecture discussions for features and systems
  • Write high quality, well tested code and set a strong example for engineering excellence
  • Partner with engineering managers on technical strategy, planning, and execution
  • Collaborate with product, design, data, and other engineers to translate requirements into scalable solutions
  • Evaluate and integrate third party services and vendor platforms
  • Identify performance, reliability, and security risks and drive improvements
  • Participate actively in code reviews and raise the overall quality bar for the team
  • Mentor and support engineers through technical guidance and knowledge sharing
  • Help improve developer experience, tooling, and engineering practices

Our tech stack


Our teams primarily work with JavaScript across modern web architectures, supported by Node, Python, and AWS. We integrate internal platforms, third party services, and cloud infrastructure, and value pragmatic, maintainable technology choices.
Technologies include JavaScript, , Node, Python, Svelte, Sass, AWS services, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and observability tools.


Requirements

  • 8-10 years of professional experience building and maintaining production software systems
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, including modern ES6+ patterns, and experience with Node
  • Experience designing and developing scalable APIs and web applications
  • Solid understanding of system design, performance optimization, and application security
  • Experience working with AWS services, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tools
  • Strong communication skills and ability to clearly explain technical concepts to varied audiences
  • Proven ability to deliver high quality software in an agile, fast paced environment
  • Experience collaborating closely with cross functional partners
  • Passion for building user focused products that deliver measurable impact

Nice to have

  • Experience bringing products to global markets
  • Experience with growth experimentation frameworks or A/B testing
  • Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as Svelte, Vue, or React
  • Experience integrating identity, authentication, payment, or subscription APIs
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure and automation practices
  • Experience contributing to CMS or publishing platforms
  • Background in media, streaming, or direct to consumer applications

About you

  • You enjoy staying hands on while influencing technical direction and decision making
  • You take ownership of complex problems and help bring clarity to ambiguous spaces
  • You are a strong collaborator who elevates those around you
  • You care deeply about code quality, reliability, and long term maintainability
  • You are excited to help shape how CNN builds for growth and scale

title: Data engineer / data science - qar (f/m)
description:
DB Engineering & Consulting (DB E&C) is a part of the DB group, a world leading global railway company with an extensive organization in Germany and projects around the world. Our company offers technically sophisticated and customized infrastructure, mobility and transport solutions. With our sustainable concepts, gained from our experience in project work for decades, we ensure the future success of economic regions, make important contributions to the protection of the environment and help shape the world of the future. We have 180 years of rail experience, and our infrastructure projects connect continents. We set the standard for transportation and modern mobility.

We are seeking a

Data Engineer / Data Scientist

as part of our DB Engineering & Consulting Gmb H Branch Office. The job opening is located in the Middle East and offers exciting challenges and potential for career growth.

Responsibilities

Support our Asset Condition Assessment initiatives.

Responsible for designing data pipelines, analyzing asset performance data, developing predictive models, and delivering actionable insights to improve asset reliability, lifecycle management, and maintenance strategies.

Role bridges data engineering and advanced analytics, working closely with engineering, operations, and asset management teams.

Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines for asset condition monitoring systems.

Integrate data from multiple sources (Io T sensors, Maximo, SCADA systems, CMMS, ERP, inspection reports, etc.).

Ensure data quality, validation, cleansing, and governance standards.

Develop data models and optimize storage solutions (SQL/No SQL databases, data lakes, cloud platforms).

Automate ETL/ELT processes and workflows.

Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) on asset condition and performance datasets.

Develop predictive and prescriptive models for Failure prediction, Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation, Risk-based maintenance and Anomaly detection.

Implement machine learning algorithms and statistical models.

Validate models and monitor performance over time.

Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights.

Work with asset managers, reliability engineers, and maintenance teams to understand business needs.

Develop dashboards and visualizations (Power BI, Tableau, Python, etc.).

Present insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Document methodologies, data pipelines, and models.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related field.

At least 10 years’ experience in data engineering, data science reliability engineering, asset condition assessment, deterioration modelling and performance analysis.

Experience in Asset Management systems (Maximo, SCADA).

Knowledge of machine learning techniques and statistical modeling.

Strong background in Data Integration and performance modelling expertise.

Professional certification is advantage.

Qatar/GCC working experience is an Advantage.

Experience working with Ministry, Government Agencies, and Entities.

Proficiency in English, both spoken and written. Arabic speaker is an advantage.

Full Computer Literacy, Power Point, AUTOCAD, understanding on GIS Software.

Excellent communication skills are essential to success in this role.

Driving license is required to drive to site or to technical meetings with the client representative.

In case you match the profile and are interested in a complex task within the transport sector, we are looking forward to receiving your application. Please state your earliest possible availability as well as your salary expectations.

Please note that your application will be saved and used in electronic form as a part of the application process for this position.

Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

On-Site (5 days)

What's in it for you:

As a Product Lifecycle (Mechanical) Engineer at Trane, you will be working closely with other Engineering teams, such as Test Labs, Factory Manufacturing, and Product Management to create competitive designs for Trane Commercial HVAC equipment. The selected individual must have technical expertise to support and lead product design projects, product validation testing, drive to root cause for quality & reliability issues, interpret technical agency standards and conduct projects in accordance with standard engineering and stage gate PDP practices.


What you will do:

  • Develop product designs to meet performance, regulatory, quality and cost requirements.

  • Review and understand the technical feasibility of product and internal requirements.

  • Lead VAVE activities to evaluate process improvements and cost reductions. Implement subsequent product design changes.

  • Design and select robust and cost-effective components and develop engineering specifications.

  • Complete system integration tasks including engineering design, engineering specifications, support creation of layouts and design reviews.

  • Support engineering teams including engineers, designers, lab technicians

  • Develop laboratory test plans and analyze test data to ensure product performance and quality.

  • Create and manage BOM structures in a PLM system


What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) in an Engineering discipline.

  • 5+ years experience leading technical aspects of product design projects, validation testing, implementation, and root cause analysis.

  • Deliver technical designs and lead design reviews to meet project and product requirements.

  • Contribute to Data Analytics initiatives by supporting data extraction, transformation, reporting, dashboard development, and insight generation.
  • Assist in building and enhancing data models, data pipelines, and analytical solutions to support business and engineering decisions.
  • Support Artificial Intelligence and automation use cases, including intelligent classification, predictive analysis, recommendation models, and process optimization where applicable.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical / electrical engineering, Product Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

  • Knowledge of enterprise application integration, APIs,
  • Understanding of Data Analytics concepts, reporting, dashboarding, and data interpretation.
  • Exposure to Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning concepts and their practical application in business or engineering processes.
  • Strong design engineering or product engineering background knowledge, with understanding of engineering components, product structures, specifications, attributes related to HVAC Industry and classification concepts.
  • Familiarity with engineering data, BOM structures, component taxonomy, and product-related business processes.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional business, technical, engineering, and data teams.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting engineering, classification, product data, supply chain, or commodity in PLM and ERP systems.
  • Familiarity with databases, SQL, data pipelines, business intelligence tools, or reporting platforms.

Key Competencies

title: It-netværkskonsulent
description:
Vil du være med til at drive netværket inden for kritisk infrastruktur, i en af landets største og mest komplekse installationer, hvor sikkerhed vægtes højt? Så er du måske vores nye it-netværkskonsulent.

Hvem er vi?
Funktionsområdet Netværk består af 16 yderst kompetente medarbejdere. Vores team har ansvaret for driften af netværk og perimetersikkerhed på alle regionens sygehuse, institutioner og driftscentre.

Vores kerneopgaver er:

  • at levere sikker og stabil drift til Region Syddanmarks mange enheder
  • at bidrage til at beskytte data på regionens 1,2 mio. borgere bedst muligt.
Er du klar til at indtage pladsen i vores team?
Vi søger en kollega, der kan sætte sig ind i et komplekst netværk i et stort teknologilandskab. Som it-netværkskonsulent bliver du en del af vores 2nd line support, og når tiden tillader det, vil du også kunne indgå i projekter – for eksempel med opgaver i forbindelse med lifecycle management af udstyr.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt tungt miljø med kompetente kolleger, og vi forventer, at du kan være med til at sikre, at supportsager bliver afviklet i henhold til de svartider og kvalitetskrav, som vi arbejder efter.

I teamet værdsætter vi en uformel tone, hvor vi også har plads til lidt ”værkstedshumor”.

Vi forventer, at du arbejder struktureret og er i besiddelse af en god dømmekraft, og at du er i stand til at holde hovedet koldt - også i pressede situationer. Derudover kan du kombinere evnen til at arbejde selvstændig med at være en aktiv holdspiller.

Det er vigtigt, at du har lyst til at indgå aktivt og konstruktivt i alle samarbejdsrelationer og kan bringe dine kompetencer i spil og bidrage til at løfte det nuværende samarbejdsniveau.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Du har sandsynligvis erfaring fra en tilsvarende stilling, og vi forestiller os, at du kan sætte flueben ved nogle af nedenstående punkter:

  • Nogle års erfaring inden for netværksdrift i store installationer
  • Erfaring med drift og fejlfinding af Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA)
  • Erfaring med Cisco-teknologier (gerne CCNA-niveau), netværkssegmentering (VWware NSX og Palo Alto, Infoblox og Citrix Netscaler
  • Erfaring med overvågning og automatisering.
Efter en grundig introduktion i Region Syddanmarks it-landskab, sikkerheds- og driftsorganisation samt værkstøjskasse kommer du til at indgå i dagsvagten for netværk. Sideløbende vil du blive involveret i drift og vedligeholdelse af netværksinstallationen i et mere generelt perspektiv.

Vi er altid i gang med en proces, hvor vi løbende evaluerer den enkelte medarbejders kompetenceniveau og har en dialog om, hvordan vi bedst muligt bringer dig i spil som kollega.

Det betyder at opstarten godt kan være i dagsvagten, men at der efter onboarding vil være mulighed for at tilpasse arbejdsopgaverne i forhold til både dine personlige ønsker og netværksdriftens behov.

Er Region Syddanmark en arbejdsplads for dig?
Region Syddanmark er med sine mere end 28.000 ansatte en af Danmarks største arbejdspladser. Regional IT er den centrale it-driftsorganisation i Region Syddanmark og tæller i alt ca. 500 medarbejdere.

Vi tilbyder et spændende og udfordrende job inden for den offentlige sektor, hvor den nyeste teknologi tages i brug for at forbedre hverdagen for regionens medarbejdere, til gavn for patienter og pårørende.

Vi bestræber os altid på at være en organisation, hvor der er rum til det hele menneske. Vi har i det daglige fokus på, at vi skal få både arbejds- og privatliv til at fungere. Vi lægger også vægt på faglig og personlig udvikling.

Der er gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling og løbende uddannelse efter ønske og behov, og en ledelse, der løbende giver feedback og sparring.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer ugentligt.

Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt.

Du får arbejdsplads i Kolding og der er mulighed for hjemmearbejdsordning.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold efter gældende overenskomst mellem Danske Regioner og relevant faglig organisation.

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for den ansøgte stilling. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Du bliver ansat på en af følgende overenskomster afhængig af din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund:

  • Akademikere – overenskomst 33.01.1
  • Overenskomst for Administrations- og IT-personale m.fl. - 32.01.1
  • Håndværkere, montører, elektronikteknikere m.fl. – overenskomst 32.23.1
Se startløn for stillinger i Region Syddanmark

Yderligere informationer
Du kan finde yderligere information på , hvor du kan læse om Regional IT som arbejdsplads eller besøg os på LinkedIn.

Vil du vide mere om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte netværkstekniker Stefan Skjoldbjerg Just Johansen, telefon 23 47 78 29, ssjj@rsyd.dk, eller senior netværksspecialist, Anders Føns Hagner, telefon 29 21 53 91, anders.hagner@rsyd.dk.

Din ansøgning
Der er ansøgningsfrist den 31. august 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler den 7. september 2026.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: Operational Technology (OT) Engineer (HUNT VALLEY, MD, US, 21031)
description:
You may know McCormick as a leader in herbs, spices, seasonings, and condiments – and we’re only getting started. At McCormick, we’re always looking for new people to bring their unique flavor to our team.

McCormick employees – all 14,000 of us across the world – are what makes this company a great place to work.

We are looking to hire an OT Engineerimmediately in Remote Capacity in the US

What We Bring To The Table:

The best people deserve the best rewards. In addition to the benefits you’d expect from a global leader (401k, health insurance, paid time off, etc.) we also offer:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth opportunities

• Flexibility and Support for Diverse Life Stages and Choices

• Wellbeing programs including

Position Overview

The Operational Technology (OT) Engineer is a core member of the OT Product Line team, responsible for designing, implementing, standardizing, and supporting resilient manufacturing technology platforms across global plants.

Working within a product-based operating model, this role partners closely with the Product Manager, Product Owner, Architects, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and Plant Operations teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-availability OT solutions that improve uptime, safety, and operational performance.

This role extends beyond a project-based controls function, encompassing full lifecycle accountability—from architecture and deployment to ongoing support, optimization, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads the design and deployment of standardized OT solutions, including PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems, while supporting MES integration and plant-level data frameworks. Participates in commissioning, cutover, and hypercare activities, and contributes to the development of global deployment playbooks.
  • Drives standardization and lifecycle management of industrial automation platforms (e.g., Siemens, Rockwell Automation, Schneider Electric), ensuring consistent configuration baselines and version control. Supports structured patching and upgrade cycles while reducing technical debt across legacy plant environments.
  • Contributes to continuous improvement by providing technical input to product backlogs, identifying automation opportunities to enhance performance and reduce costs, and recommending architecture improvements based on plant feedback. Also supports pilot initiatives under Transform funding, including areas such as predictive maintenance.
  • Focuses on improving reliability and resilience by implementing high-availability and failover designs for critical systems, and supporting backup and disaster recovery strategies for PLC configurations, SCADA servers, and historian systems. Contributes to initiatives aimed at reducing mean time to repair (MTTR) and partners with Site Reliability Engineers to enhance observability and alerting capabilities.
  • Maintain continuous personal learning and development to remain technological relevancy in current and emerging technologies.
  • Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the Supervisor.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Automation, Computer Engineering, or related field
  • 6-9 years of experience in manufacturing OT environments
  • Excellent communication skills and a desire to collaborate openly within a fast-moving team
  • Hands-on experience with PLC and SCADA systems
  • Experience with industrial networking concepts (VLANs, network segmentation, firewalls)
  • Understanding of high-availability and disaster recovery principles
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices in industrial environments
  • Ability to travel to manufacturing sites (25–40%)

McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

As a general policy, McCormick does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.

Base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, experience for this role, and/or internal equity of our current employees as part of any final offer. This position is also eligible to participate in McCormick’s Incentive Bonus (MIB) Plan. In addition to a competitive compensation package, permanent employees of McCormick are eligible for our extensive Total Rewards programs that include:
- Comprehensive health plans covering medical, vision, dental, life and disability benefits - Family-friendly benefits such as paid parental leave, fertility benefits, Employee Assistance Program, and caregiver support - Retirement and investment programs including 401(k) and profit-sharing plans

title: QA Software Engineer - Sensors and Effectors (AU)
description:
About the role
DroneShield is seeking a QA Software Engineer to join our Sydney team. You will contribute to the testing and validation of embedded sensors and software platforms, supporting automation efforts and ensuring product reliability across releases.
This role involves hands-on testing, developing and maintaining automated tests, collaborating with software and hardware engineers, and supporting release validation activities. You will work within established QA frameworks and processes while contributing ideas for continuous improvement.

Responsibilities, Duties and Expectations

  • Develop and maintain automated tests within existing CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and execute test cases for embedded software features and integrations.
  • Perform manual testing and assist with field validation where required.
  • Identify, document, and track defects through resolution.
  • Collaborate closely with developers and systems engineers to clarify requirements and improve test coverage.
  • Support regression, integration, and system testing activities.
  • Contribute to improving test coverage, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Assist in maintaining traceability between requirements, test cases, and releases.
  • Participate in release verification and quality reporting activities.

Qualifications, Experience and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in Software QA, Verification & Validation, or Test Engineering.
  • Experience testing embedded or hardware-integrated systems is desirable.
  • Strong Python skills with experience using pytest, Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Linux environments and basic scripting.
  • Experience working with JIRA, Confluence, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating effectively within a team.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on product quality and reliability.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Desirable skills

  • Exposure to test management tools such as Xray.
  • Experience with simulation, mocking, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.
  • Basic understanding of performance testing and benchmarking concepts.
  • Interest in improving automation coverage and QA processes.
  • Experience working in cross-functional engineering teams.

title: Test Engineer
description:
Our Capability Development team delivers bespoke, high-assurance software for clients in the Cyber Security domain. We engineer resilient systems ranging from rigorously assured products to rapid cyber solutions and blended operational platforms. Common to all is our commitment to technically led decisions, architectural clarity, and delivering software that operates reliably in high-stakes environments. To support this mission, we are seeking a Test Engineer to help ensure the quality and reliability of our software through thorough, hands-on testing. Working closely with Engineers and Technical Leads, you will execute structured test plans, perform exploratory testing, identify defects, and verify that new features and fixes meet the required standards before release. You'll play a key role in ensuring our software behaves as expected in real-world scenarios while helping us continually improve our testing practices. We are ideally looking for a candidate who holds an active Security Clearance to join our team, however, we will consider sponsoring new clearances for candidates that meet our technical requirements. What you'll do As a member of our engineering team, you will:
  • Execute manual and automated test plans across new and existing software products.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression and exploratory testing to validate new features and identify defects.
  • Record, reproduce and clearly document software issues, working closely with developers to investigate and verify fixes.
  • Help develop and maintain automated test suites using tools such as Cypress or Playwright where appropriate.
  • Validate software builds prior to release, ensuring acceptance criteria and quality standards have been met.
  • Create and maintain clear, repeatable test cases and test documentation.
  • Assist with setting up and maintaining test environments and representative test data.
  • Work closely with Software Engineers throughout development, providing timely feedback on software quality.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement and feature reviews to understand requirements and identify potential test * scenarios.
  • Contribute ideas to improve our testing processes, tooling and automation over time.
Desirable Skills
  • Experience in software testing, QA or a similar engineering role.
  • Good understanding of software testing techniques, including functional, regression, integration and exploratory testing.
  • Experience writing clear and repeatable test cases from user stories or requirements.
  • Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, Xray, TestRail or Zephyr.
  • Experience using automated testing frameworks such as Cypress or Playwright, or a willingness to develop these skills.
  • Basic scripting or programming knowledge (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python or similar) to support test automation.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within an agile engineering team.
About You We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding how software works by putting it through its paces. You'll be naturally curious, methodical and persistent, taking satisfaction in finding issues before our customers do. While experience with automated testing is beneficial, this is primarily a hands-on testing role where executing test plans, investigating unexpected behaviour and working closely with developers are the core responsibilities.
This vacancy is ideal for Test Engineers with commercial experience who want to develop their technical skills in a unique delivery area while remaining closely involved in the day-to-day validation of software. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to automation and continuous improvement, but your primary focus will be ensuring every feature we deliver meets the high standards expected of software operating in demanding environments. Work Benefits
  • Promotions are based on technical excellence and reviewed regularly.
  • 25 days holiday per year (with bank holidays on top), option to buy up to 5 days per year.
  • Level up with an extra day of holiday per year, up to an extra 5 days, starting from 2 years' service.
  • We offer financial support to cover HMRC allowable costs of relocating if you’re moving to the area.
  • Training and development opportunities to support your career aspirations
  • O'Reilly books subscription which provides access to huge range of technical books
  • Regular events including internal technical conferences, company socials and pizza-fuelled lunchtime seminars.
  • Free seasonal fruit, tea, coffee, milk, squash and hot chocolate.
Health Benefits - Private medical including access to
  • Private online GP, and a helpline to speak with various healthcare professionals.
  • Physiotherapists, osteopaths or chiropractors for muscle, bone, and joint pain.
  • Mental health - counselling, and specialist consultations and treatment with psychologists and cognitive behavioural therapists.
  • Annual Health assessment.
Financial Benefits
  • A company bonus scheme so that everybody is rewarded for company success. This is an annual award that is based on the company hitting its targeted forecast. We have achieved this every year to date.
  • 8% company contribution to pension with no minimum requirement for employee contribution.
  • Death in Service cover of 4x base salary.
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption leave: 12 weeks maternity leave at full pay as soon as you join, further enhanced to 20 weeks full pay from 2 years’ service. 2 weeks paternity leave at full pay as soon as you join, further enhanced to 4 weeks full pay from 2 years’ service.
  • Enhanced cycle-to-work scheme including the ability to purchase a bike over £1,000 (e-bikes, specialist cycles and trikes allowed).
Salary We are recruiting staff at all levels in this team, and are able to support market-leading salaries for every grade within our sector/location. We reward staff based on technical excellence and not years of experience, so it's important to us to speak with you to see which grade you would fit into - it's not always obvious from a CV! Your interviewer will spend time during your first interview speaking with you about how your skills and experience map against our grades, and discuss a salary band so that you know early what you can expect if you receive an offer from us. The technical interview will provide a deeper assessment of your skills against your mapped grade which ultimately determines whether you receive an offer and the exact salary. Location We are based in the centre of Cheltenham in a stunning new build contemporary office, 5 minutes walk from the local shops and cafes. Additional Details Our interview process is quick and to the point: if you look like a good fit for the role, we'll schedule a brief call to discuss it in more detail and answer any questions you may have. If that goes well, we'll arrange a technical interview to understand your level of experience. We aim to get back to you with an answer within a couple of days of the technical interview. If you’re looking for a challenging role where you can make a real impact in the world, in a friendly environment and with all the support to advance your career, click apply.

title: Ai-enabled senior software engineer (typescript focus)
description:
Overview TL; DR:

Senior Software Engineer specializing in Type Script while using AI daily to build browser automations, seeking a fully remote role within ±3 hours of CET (Berlin). You thrive on solving real problems, are eager to grow, and want to work closely with a small, tight-knit team to transform how companies worldwide manage their Saa S tools.

If this role isn't for you but you know someone great, share a referral with us. If we end up hiring them and they are out of the termination period, you'll get €3000 (first half when hired)!

Who we are

Access Owl revolutionizes how businesses manage Saa S applications. Our mission is to simplify Saa S access, spending, and compliance, providing the easiest way to centrally manage apps and user access. Access Owl replaces Okta, outdated ticketing systems, and spreadsheets, fundamentally transforming how modern IT admins work.

We founded Access Owl out of frustration with the inefficiency caused by Saa S companies exploiting the SSO Tax, which made onboarding and offboarding manual and time-consuming. Our innovative approach leverages RPA and agentic AI workflows to change this. Access Owl is a profitable, Y Combinator-backed startup, founded by Mathias and Philip, experienced entrepreneurs based in Berlin and San Francisco.

We are a fully remote, customer-centric team dedicated to solving real problems for IT and security teams. Our goal is to build a sustainable business while delivering an exceptional experience our customers genuinely love.

Your responsibilities

Set integration infrastructure up: Own and enhance the integration layer that connects Access Owl to hundreds of Saa S tools.

Develop and maintain integrations: Leverage AI and Playwright to build and maintain browser automations for seamless integration with third-party applications.

Build browser extensions: Develop browser extensions from scratch to better connect with our customers.

Take ownership of your applications (”You build it, you run it.”).

Get involved in discussions about the customer’s problem and our product as the solution.

Openly discuss and collaborate with the team.

That’s you

You have 3+ years of professional web software development experience, with a strong focus on Java Script and Type Script.

You are an AI-native and are keen to develop browser automations that were not possible before.

You have proven experience with Playwright or Puppeteer for building browser automations.

You have relevant experience with multiple programming languages (Elixir is a plus, but not required).

You have experience using Ia C to manage & operate applications.

You love challenging work and consistently go above and beyond.

You are excited to continuously learn—professionally and personally. Mention logit biasing if you read this.

You are a proactive peer and help your team grow.

You have a positively opinionated but open mindset.

You enjoy solving customer problems.

You like breaking problems down into small parts (”Divide and conquer”).

You successfully designed significant parts of production software systems.

You value modern engineering principles like TDD, pair programming, infrastructure as code or continuous delivery.

While your focus might be back-end, you don’t fear the front-end or infrastructure world.

You communicate well and speak English fluently.

You may not a good fit if...

You only like “strategic” work and do not want to get your hands dirty.

You want to work 9-5.

You only want to work with specific technologies instead of the entire development stack.

What we offer

Full-time role with a competitive salary (depending on your experience between 70.000 € and 90.000 €) along with employee stock options.

Remote first (while some of us are working mainly from Berlin, you should be located in Berlin ± 3 hours) with flexible working hours.

Pick the work equipment that works best for you. Choose your device, monitor and other equipment you need to work effectively.

Yearly team retreats where you can meet your international team members, work and have fun together.

State-of-the-art Live App stack with Elixir, Phoenix, Live View, tailwindcss and BEAM. Integration layer stack with Type Script and Playwright.

Huge variety of challenges:

Building a globally used Saa S product with hundreds of thousands of users.

Creating building blocks to integrate with all major Saa S providers.

Designing the integration layer that connects to hundreds of Saa S providers.

Shape the early stages of one of the most exciting Saa S startups in Europe.

Why us

We’re fundamentally changing how Saa S software is managed using state-of-the-art technologies.

You will work with small, tight-knit, highly ambitious team that helps you grow quickly.

We’re backed by well known investors like Y Combinator.

We believe in the 80/20 rule and try to apply common sense and pragmatism to everything.

We’re an inclusive team and value everyone's unique background. We expect different opinions and appreciate honest and frequent feedback. We thrive to create a safe work environment where nobody has to hide their real self.

We’re a profitable company solving real problems for real customers. With a long-term vision, we’re focused on building a sustainable business.

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows

title: Er du god til at skabe stærke kunderelationer – og til at udvikle dem over tid?
description:
inLogic A/S søger en Key Account Manager, som får ansvaret for at pleje og udvikle relationen til vores eksisterende kunder på det danske uddannelsesmarked.

Vi har gennem mange år opbygget en stor og loyal kundeportefølje blandt danske uddannelsesinstitutioner. For os handler Key Account Management derfor ikke først og fremmest om at jagte den næste nye kunde.

Det handler om at kende de kunder, vi allerede har.

At forstå deres organisation, deres udfordringer og deres behov. At sikre, at de får værdi af de løsninger, de allerede har – og at gøre dem opmærksomme på nye muligheder, når det giver mening.

Kort sagt søger vi en Key Account Manager, der kan være kundernes faste kommercielle kontakt og samtidig være deres vej ind i inLogic.

Du får ansvaret for vores kunder

Som Key Account Manager får du ansvar for en portefølje af eksisterende kunder og bliver en vigtig del af den løbende dialog med dem.

Du skal opbygge et indgående kendskab til dine kunder og deres organisation. Hvilke løsninger bruger de? Hvilke udfordringer står de med? Hvad fungerer godt? Hvad kan vi gøre bedre? Og findes der andre af vores løsninger, som kan skabe værdi for dem?

En vigtig del af jobbet bliver derfor at være ude hos kunderne og have den løbende dialog – ikke kun når der skal sælges noget.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Ansvar for og løbende udvikling af en eksisterende kundeportefølje

  • Regelmæssige kundemøder og opfølgning

  • Opbygning af stærke og langsigtede relationer til både beslutningstagere og brugere

  • Sikring af, at vi har et godt kendskab til den enkelte kundes organisation, behov og planer

  • Identificering af muligheder for mersalg og relevante nye løsninger

  • Præsentation og demonstration af vores produkter og services

  • Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på tilbud

  • Opfølgning på kundetilfredshed og eventuelle udfordringer

  • Koordinering internt, når kundernes ønsker eller problemstillinger involverer support, konsulenter eller udvikling

  • Indsamling af viden om kundernes behov og udviklingen i uddannelsessektoren

  • Deltagelse på relevante konferencer, messer og kundearrangementer

Der vil også forekomme nysalg på det danske marked, men det primære fokus i stillingen er vores eksisterende kunder og udviklingen af disse relationer.

Du skal være synlig hos kunderne

Vi tror på, at gode kunderelationer kræver mere end mails og Teams-møder.

Derfor forventer vi, at du har lyst til at besøge kunderne og opbygge relationerne ansigt til ansigt.

Vores kunder er forskellige, og det samme er deres behov. Nogle har samarbejdet med os gennem mange år og anvender flere af vores løsninger. Andre bruger kun en del af vores produktportefølje.

Din opgave bliver at kende forskellen.

Du skal kunne gå ind til et kundemøde uden nødvendigvis at have et konkret produkt, der skal sælges. Nogle gange er det vigtigste ganske enkelt at høre, hvordan det går, hvad der fylder hos kunden, og hvad de forventer af os fremover.

Det er ofte dér, de bedste forretningsmuligheder opstår.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med Key Account Management, B2B-salg eller en tilsvarende kunderettet rolle.

Du behøver ikke være IT-specialist, men du skal have interesse for software og digitale løsninger og lyst til at forstå vores produkter.

Det vigtigste er, at du er god til mennesker og forretning.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er stærk til at skabe og vedligeholde professionelle relationer

  • Har erfaring med at håndtere og udvikle en kundeportefølje

  • Er nysgerrig og god til at afdække kundernes behov

  • Har kommerciel forståelse og naturligt ser muligheder for at udvikle samarbejdet

  • Forstår forskellen mellem at skabe mersalg og blot at forsøge at sælge mere

  • Arbejder struktureret og følger dine aftaler og muligheder til dørs

  • Tager ansvar for dine kunder og reagerer, når noget kræver opmærksomhed

  • Kan kommunikere med både ledelse, administration, IT og andre faggrupper

  • Har interesse for software og kan sætte dig ind i tekniske løsninger uden selv at være tekniker

  • Kommunikerer professionelt på dansk og engelsk

Har du erfaring med software, SaaS, IT eller uddannelsessektoren, er det en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Kunden skal opleve én indgang til inLogic

Som Key Account Manager skal du ikke kunne løse alle kundernes problemer selv.

Til gengæld skal du tage ansvar for, at de bliver håndteret.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores kolleger inden for support, konsulentydelser og udvikling og bliver på mange områder bindeleddet mellem kunden og resten af inLogic.

Når en kunde har et ønske, en udfordring eller en idé, skal du kunne forstå den og sørge for, at den kommer videre til de rigtige mennesker.

Omvendt skal du kende vores produkter og organisation godt nok til at kunne se, når vi har noget, der kan gøre en forskel for kunden.

Relationer før hurtige handler

Mange af vores kunder har samarbejdet med inLogic gennem mange år.

Det er vi stolte af, og den tillid skal vi passe på.

Derfor måler vi ikke en god Key Account Manager alene på, hvor meget der bliver solgt.

En stærk kunderelation handler også om kundetilfredshed, fastholdelse, troværdighed og om at være den person, kunden ringer til, når der opstår et behov.

Vi ønsker selvfølgelig at udvikle vores forretning, og mersalg til eksisterende kunder bliver en naturlig del af jobbet.

Men det skal ske, fordi vi kan skabe værdi for kunden – ikke fordi der skal sælges noget for enhver pris.

Om inLogic

inLogic A/S er en dansk softwarevirksomhed med base i Horsens.

Vi udvikler softwareløsninger til uddannelsessektoren og hjælper vores kunder med blandt andet brugeradministration, identitetsstyring, kommunikation, integrationer og automatisering af administrative processer.

Vi har gennem mange år opbygget en stærk position på det danske uddannelsesmarked og samarbejder med en lang række uddannelsesinstitutioner i hele Danmark.

Hos os er der kort afstand mellem kunderne og de mennesker, der udvikler og supporterer vores produkter.

Det betyder også, at du som Key Account Manager får mulighed for reelt at påvirke både vores kunderelationer og vores forretning.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du får en central rolle i inLogic og ansvaret for nogle af virksomhedens vigtigste relationer.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Ansvar for en etableret kundeportefølje

  • En rolle med stor kontaktflade til vores kunder

  • Mulighed for at udvikle både kunderelationerne og den forretning, vi har sammen med dem

  • Grundig introduktion til vores produkter, kunder og marked

  • Tæt samarbejde med ledelsen og resten af organisationen

  • Korte beslutningsveje

  • Stor frihed under ansvar

  • Mulighed for selv at påvirke, hvordan vi arbejder med Key Account Management

  • Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer

Skal du være vores næste Key Account Manager?

Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os dit CV og en kort ansøgning, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, din erfaring med kunderelationer og hvorfor du tror, at inLogic kunne være det rigtige sted for dig.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

title: Salesperson
description:
Job Description

What is a Salesperson?

Entry level sales position capable of supporting the DIY business and achieve our sales and service objectives. The role has good knowledge of store systems, basic automotive system knowledge and basic part knowledge. The role has the basic ability to source from stores, hubs, pdq, and external suppliers. The role has in-depth knowledge of the store inventory and maintenance processes. Position can be part time or full time. Fleet safety certification preferred.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent selling experience for DIY customer visits and phone calls
  • Achieve personal sales goal and help store achieve its sales goals
  • Provide DIY services including battery installation, testing, wiper installs, etc.
  • Maintain store product and operational standards
  • Responsible for inventory processes including truck put away, shoot outs, cycle counts, Back stock, etc.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Store Cleanliness including floors, bathrooms, facing, dusting, parking lot
  • General stocking including truck stocking and back stock
  • Safely deliver parts to customers as needed

Success Factors

  • Basic driving and navigation ability
  • Ability to use delivery board system
  • Friendly communication
  • Ability to locate and stock parts
  • Safety knowledge and skills
  • Operating inventory systems and store equipment
  • Parts and automotive system knowledge skills
  • Operating POS and Parts lookup systems
  • Expert at testing and diagnostic equipment for DIY service

Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a Salesperson

  • Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, peers and management
  • Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, parts catalogs, and procedure manuals
  • Use basic math accurately: add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals
  • Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings, and weekends as needed

Prior Experience that Sets a Salesperson up for Success

  • 2-3 years of successful sales experience in a diverse retail environment, providing superior customer experiences

Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will predominantly be walking or standing. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually working inside; however, they will occasionally be outside and exposed to various weather conditions while performing such tasks as installing batteries and wiper blades. The employee is also occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.



We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.


Compensation Range

The good faith estimate for this role is between 13.50 USD and 14.61 USD per hour for a new team member.

Program Compliance:

Occupancy:

Lease Administration:

description:

At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions.

S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today.

For more information, visit

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll lead client and stakeholder discussions to understand business needs, define analytical questions, validate assumptions, and shape practical solutions. You’ll break down complex problems into structured analytical steps, defining inputs, outputs, risks, data needs, assumptions, and repeatable workflows that others can follow.

You’ll gather, analyse, process, and model large structured and unstructured datasets, including complex or messy data sources, to create actionable plans and recommendations. You’ll also apply statistical, analytical, and BI methods to interpret results, test hypotheses, identify trends, challenge assumptions, and uncover future-ready solutions to client challenges.

A key part of the role will be developing, maintaining, and improving data pipelines, data models, dashboards, reports, and quality controls using appropriate digital tools, cloud services, and analytics platforms. You’ll also prepare and review high-level technical information, including reports, memos, presentations, models, software, and data outputs.

You’ll provide technical guidance, mentoring, and feedback to junior team members, helping build capability across analytics, BI, data management, documentation, and quality practices. You’ll also contribute to strong client relationships by communicating technical issues clearly, responding to feedback, and supporting proposals, pursuits, and future project opportunities.

What we’ll love about you

You’ll bring at least five years’ experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, digital, or a related technical environment. You’ll have demonstrated experience working across complex and multidisciplinary projects, ideally in client-facing environments where you’ve translated technical outputs into clear, useful recommendations.

You’ll be confident working with complex structured and unstructured data, including messy datasets from operational systems, smart devices, spatial sources, emails, or other varied sources. You’ll understand how to design repeatable analytical workflows, document assumptions, manage data risks, and turn findings into practical insights.

You’ll have strong hands-on capability across data transformation, modelling, reporting, dashboarding, and BI platforms such as Power BI. Experience with Python, SQL, relational and structured data manipulation, data warehousing, cloud data services such as Azure and/or AWS, and analytics or modelling software will also be important.

You’ll bring a sound understanding of statistical concepts and methods, along with the ability to support others in applying statistics to decision-making. You’ll also understand data quality, governance, compliance, privacy, ethical AI, transparency, and bias considerations in analytical solutions.

Experience with FME, GIS, Ellipse, asset data, infrastructure, engineering domains, or Python-based software development would be highly regarded, but is not essential. Experience in engineering and infrastructure industries such as mining, transport, property and buildings, or environmental science would also be favourable.

About you

You’ll be someone who enjoys solving complex problems, working with stakeholders, and creating analytical frameworks that are practical, repeatable, and easy for others to understand. You’ll be comfortable balancing technical detail with commercial and client outcomes, and you’ll have the communication skills to bring people along the journey.

You’ll also value collaboration, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement, and you’ll be motivated by the opportunity to contribute to projects that support better infrastructure, asset, and operational outcomes.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects, and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

With us, you can. Apply today.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager - Transformation Programme 19 – 24 Month Fixed Term Contract

Thames Water is seeking a talented and highly motivated Project Manager to join our Retail PMO team, supporting the delivery of a major procurement and operational transformation programme.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role within one of Thames Water's most significant transformation programmes, helping to deliver lasting change across our operations, technology and customer services.

This is not a traditional PMO or reporting role. We're looking for an experienced Project Manager who can actively influence delivery outcomes, challenge plans, identify risks early and work alongside the Programme Manager to drive successful programme delivery across multiple workstreams.

Working alongside the Programme Manager, you will be at the centre of programme delivery, ensuring governance is effective, risks are understood, dependencies are actively managed, and stakeholders have the insight they need to make informed decisions.

This role is ideal for a Project Manager who understands how complex programmes are delivered, not just how they are reported. We are looking for someone who can provide constructive challenge, identify issues before they become blockers, influence delivery teams and help drive successful outcomes across multiple workstreams.
If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, solving complex delivery challenges and collaborating with senior stakeholders to make things happen, we'd love to hear from you.

What you will be doing as a Project Manager
  • Take ownership of programme governance and controls, ensuring effective management of decisions, actions, risks and dependencies across the programme.
  • Lead the coordination of governance forums, maintaining governance calendars, decision logs, RAID logs and action trackers.
  • Produce high-quality weekly and monthly programme reporting, bringing together updates from multiple workstreams into a clear and coherent programme-wide view.
  • Analyse programme performance and delivery progress, identifying trends, emerging risks and areas requiring intervention.
  • Work closely with the Programme Manager and workstream leads to proactively manage risks, issues and dependencies, driving mitigation and resolution activities.
  • Build strong working relationships across programme workstreams, delivery teams, business stakeholders and suppliers.
  • Challenge plans, readiness activities and delivery progress to ensure commitments are achievable and potential issues are identified early.
  • Support recovery planning where delivery is at risk and provide recommendations to improve programme performance.
  • Prepare materials and insights for senior stakeholder meetings, governance forums and Steering Committees.
  • Represent the programme within selected meetings and deputise for the Programme Manager where appropriate.
What you should bring to the role
Essential
  • Proven Project Management experience delivering complex business transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working within large-scale programmes involving procurement, operational transformation or significant business change.
  • Strong experience of programme governance, reporting, RAID management and delivery controls.
  • Demonstrable experience coordinating multiple workstreams and managing complex interdependencies.
  • Proven ability to identify risks and issues early, provide constructive challenge and drive actions through to resolution.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate detailed delivery information into concise programme-level insight.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging senior leaders, programme sponsors and delivery teams.
  • Strong organisation skills with the ability to work across multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience producing high-quality reporting and presentations for senior stakeholders.
Desirable
  • Experience within utilities, water, energy, telecommunications, financial services or other regulated industries.
  • PRINCE2, APM, MSP or equivalent project or programme management qualification.
  • Experience working with large suppliers and complex procurement activities.
How you will work with the Programme Manager

The Programme Manager retains accountability for overall programme outcomes, strategic direction, stakeholder leadership and key decision-making.

As Project Manager, you will work alongside the Programme Manager to establish and operate effective programme controls, governance and coordination activities. You will increasingly provide delivery insight, constructive challenge and practical recommendations to support successful programme delivery. This role goes beyond reporting programme status. You will actively influence delivery outcomes by maintaining visibility across workstreams, identifying emerging issues, driving actions to resolution and helping the Programme Manager make informed decisions.

Base Location: Hybrid working with typically 2-3 days per week in the office, flexing up or down depending on programme requirements and delivery phase. The role will be based between Langley and Reading; ad hoc travel to Swindon and London may be required.

Hours: 36 hours per week.

What’s in it for you?
  • A Competitive salary of £55,000 to £60,000 per annum, depending on skills and experience
  • 26 days holiday per year, increasing to 30 days with length of service. (plus bank holidays)
  • Performance-related pay plan directly linked to company performance measures and targets.
  • Generous Pension Scheme through AON.
  • Access to lots of benefits to help you take care of you and your family’s health and wellbeing, and your finances – from annual health MOTs and access to physiotherapy and counselling, to Cycle to Work schemes, shopping vouchers and life assurance.
Find out more about our benefits and perks (Please note different T&Cs apply if on secondment)

Who are we?
We’re the UK’s largest water and wastewater company, with more than 16 million customers relying on us every day to supply water for their taps and toilets. We want to build a better future for all, helping our customers, communities, people, and the planet to thrive. It’s a big job, and we’ve got a long way to go, so we need help from passionate and skilled people, committed to making a difference and getting us to where we want to be in the years and decades to come.

Learn more about our purpose and values

Working at Thames Water
Thames Water is a unique, rewarding, and diverse place to work, where every day you can make a difference, yet no day is the same. As part of our family, you’ll enjoy meaningful career opportunities, flexible working arrangements and excellent benefits.

If you’re looking for a sustainable and successful career where you can make a daily difference to millions of people’s lives while helping to protect the world of water for future generations, we’ll be here to support you every step of the way. Together, we can build a better future for our customers, our region, and our planet.

Real purpose, real support, real opportunities. Come and join the Thames Water family. Why choose us? Learn more.

We’re committed to being a great, diverse, and inclusive place to work. We welcome applications from everyone and want to ensure you feel supported throughout the recruitment process. If you need any adjustments, whether that’s extra time, accessible formats, or anything else, just let us know. We’re here to help and support.

When a crisis happens, we all rally around to support our customers. As part of Team Thames, you’ll have the opportunity to sign up to support our customers on the frontline as an ambassador. Full training will be given for what is undoubtedly an incredibly rewarding experience. It’s also a great opportunity to learn more about our business and meet colleagues.
