title: Director, Medical Training
description:
The Director Medical Training is a highly visible enterprise leader who will shape how Medical teams across the full US BBBU portfolio build and apply the scientific and clinical capabilities needed to deliver meaningful impact for patients and healthcare systems. This role owns the end-to-end clinical learning strategy and execution for Medical HQ and field teams, creating an integrated learning ecosystem that accelerates launch and lifecycle readiness, strengthens scientific expertise and Medical capabilities, and elevates the quality of external scientific engagement across therapy areas. Working with Medical leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, the Director will translate US Medical strategy, portfolio priorities, global standards, and regulatory requirements into scalable learning experiences that enable teams to turn science, evidence, and insights into action. Reporting to the Head of Medical Excellence, this individual will have a pivotal opportunity to define the future of clinical learning across BBU Medical and strengthen the readiness and effectiveness of teams across the portfolio.

Accountabilities

  • Define and own the multi-year clinical learning strategy for Medical across the full BBU portfolio, covering onboarding, role-based capability development, launch and lifecycle readiness, team learning and effectiveness, compliance certification, field coaching and continuous learning.

  • Own the development, implementation, and ongoing assessment of a consistent field coaching approach, equipping Medical leaders and people managers with the tools, standards, and insights needed to strengthen capability, reinforce learning, and improve field performance.

  • Build an integrated portfolio learning roadmap that balances enterprise-wide standards with therapy-area, asset, and role-specific needs across HQ and field Medical teams.

  • Lead learning-needs assessments and capability-gap analyses using Medical strategy, portfolio milestones, learner feedback, performance data, and evolving scientific and healthcare-system needs.

  • Design and oversee competency-based curricula that integrate disease-state knowledge, product and pipeline science, clinical evidence, treatment guidelines, evidence literacy, scientific narratives, insight generation, digital engagement, and Medical ways of working.

  • Own clinical learning readiness for launches and major lifecycle milestones, from requirements definition and content development through assessments, certification, reinforcement, and measurement.

  • Establish consistent onboarding and first-90-day learning experiences for Medical roles, with clear proficiency expectations and pathways for ongoing role-specific development.

  • Set learning standards for high-quality, compliant scientific exchange and external engagement, including appropriate preparation for field and HQ Medical interactions.

  • Determine and manage the optimal mix of instructor-led, virtual, digital, simulation-based, social, and microlearning approaches to improve proficiency, retention, and application.

  • Ensure all learning content is scientifically accurate, balanced, current, and compliant with applicable medical, legal, regulatory, and internal standards; maintain audit-ready governance and documentation.

  • Partner with Medical leadership, therapy-area teams, Field Medical, Medical Excellence, Scientific Communications, Evidence, Digital, Compliance, Regulatory, Global Medical, and other relevant functions to align priorities and coordinate delivery.

  • Lead the governance, prioritization, and demand-planning process for Medical learning across the portfolio, clarifying decision rights, timelines, resource needs, and dependencies.

  • Define success measures and dashboards, including proficiency, completion and certification, time-to-readiness, learner confidence, application, and Medical-impact indicators; use insights to continuously improve solutions.

  • Drive adoption of learning platforms, content-management systems, Medical technologies, and analytics tools that improve access, scalability, personalization, and measurement.

  • Lead change management and communications for major learning initiatives, equipping Medical leaders and people managers to reinforce learning and coach for sustained application.

  • Manage budgets, vendors, agencies, and technology partners to deliver high-quality learning solutions on time and within agreed resources.

  • Build reusable standards, playbooks, and communities of practice that enable sharing across therapy areas, reduce duplication, and scale effective approaches across BBU Medical.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, education, organizational development, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in Medical Affairs, field medical, medical education, clinical learning, scientific training, or learning and development within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare sector.

  • Demonstrated success developing and deploying competency-based clinical or scientific learning programs at scale across multiple brands, assets, therapy areas, or Medical roles.

  • Experience leading learning strategy and readiness for product launches, indication expansions, and lifecycle milestones in a regulated environment.

  • Strong scientific and clinical acumen, with the ability to translate complex evidence, data, and medical strategy into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences.

  • Knowledge of Medical Affairs operating models, field and HQ Medical roles, scientific exchange, insight generation, evidence dissemination, and applicable compliance requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders within a complex, matrixed organization.

  • Experience establishing learning governance, assessments, certification or proficiency frameworks, and meaningful measures of learner readiness and impact.

  • Strong program and portfolio management skills, including prioritization, budget stewardship, vendor oversight, risk management, and delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, consulting, and change-leadership skills.

Desirable Skills/Experience

  • Advanced scientific, clinical, education, or business degree preferred (e.g., PharmD, PhD, MD, EdD, MS, MBA).

  • Experience across more than one therapeutic area and familiarity with a broad biopharmaceutical portfolio.

  • Prior experience supporting both field and HQ Medical populations, including MSL or other scientific-engagement roles.

  • Experience with adult-learning principles, instructional design, simulation, coaching, and modern assessment practices.

  • Familiarity with LMS/LXP platforms, content-authoring tools, virtual learning technologies, Medical systems, and analytics dashboards.

  • Track record of leading enterprise capability transformation, establishing common learning standards, or building a Medical learning operating model.

  • People leadership or significant matrix-team leadership experience.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer SDET
description:
Description

Engagement Overview


EMS|MC is seeking an experienced independent contractor to provide software quality assurance and test engineering services supporting its Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) platform. The engagement will focus on designing and implementing automated testing solutions, integrating continuous testing within AWS-based delivery pipelines, and performing targeted exploratory testing to validate complex enterprise workflows. The selected contractor will deliver scalable, high-quality testing solutions that help ensure reliable, secure, and production-ready software.


Scope of Services

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining automated test frameworks for web applications, RESTful APIs, and microservices.
  • Developing automated integration, component, and API tests using C# and/or TypeScript.
  • Integrating automated testing into AWS-based CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery.
  • Developing sufficient familiarity with the applicable platforms, systems, integrations, data flows, and technology stack to inform test design, automation strategy, and troubleshooting.
  • Performing exploratory and risk-based testing for complex enterprise software solutions.
  • Executing complex SQL queries across relational databases, including SQL Server and PostgreSQL, to validate transactional integrity, data transformations, state persistence, application functionality, and data accuracy.
  • Participating in technical and architectural design discussions to identify quality risks, boundary conditions, edge cases, security vulnerabilities, and appropriate testing strategies.
  • Consulting with designated EMS|MC stakeholders to refine quality strategies, clarify test requirements, manage testing scope, and align quality efforts with business priorities and agreed-upon acceptance criteria.
  • Investigating software defects by reviewing system logs, tracing API calls, inspecting database states, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with technical stakeholders to prevent recurrence.
  • Developing and maintaining testing utilities, integration test harnesses, automation tools, quality engineering processes, and test suites with appropriate logging and metrics to support rapid debugging.
  • Supporting testing activities that align with applicable security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, including access controls, audit logging, token-based authentication, HIPAA/PHI, PCI-DSS, SOC, and OWASP principles.
  • Preparing documentation related to testing strategies, automation frameworks, verification workflows, and quality recommendations.

Expected Deliverables

  • Automated test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and enterprise services that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with engagement requirements.
  • Automated integration, component, regression, and API test suites supporting new product features and enhancements.
  • Testing strategies and quality recommendations that improve software reliability and reduce production defects.
  • Continuous integration testing capabilities integrated into AWS-based CI/CD pipelines.
  • Exploratory testing results, defect documentation, and recommendations for risk mitigation on complex enterprise workflows.
  • SQL-based validation of application functionality, data integrity, and business processes.
  • Root cause analysis and documentation for identified software defects, including recommendations to prevent recurrence.
  • Technical documentation supporting test automation, testing methodologies, and quality engineering best practices.
  • Knowledge transfer, documentation, or walkthrough sessions, as requested, to support ongoing continuity.


Requirements

Contractor Qualifications

  • Five (5) or more years providing software quality engineering or SDET services supporting enterprise software applications.
  • Strong programming experience using C# and/or TypeScript/JavaScript with the ability to write clean, maintainable, object-oriented test automation code.
  • Experience in modern UI test frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium, specifically applied to complex single-page applications built in Angular.
  • Experience in API testing such as REST, JSON, Postman, RestSharp, or custom C#/TypeScript API test harnesses, including testing async messaging and event-driven patterns.
  • Strong database engineering and SQL proficiency with the ability to write non-trivial SQL queries (JOINs, aggregations, data profiling) to verify data pipeline outputs, transactional state, and database integrity.
  • Experience working within AWS cloud environments.
  • Understanding of data privacy, auditability, and security concepts relevant to regulated industries such as HIPAA/PHI, PCI-DSS, SOC, and OWASP Top 10.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to articulate complex quality concepts and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Additional Experience Preferred

  • Experience testing within Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Healthcare IT, Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, or other highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps methodologies, and automated deployment practices.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and cloud deployment patterns.
  • Performance, load, stress, or scalability testing using tools such as k6, JMeter, or comparable platforms.
  • Agile and Kanban software development environments with an emphasis on continuous delivery.

Engagement Details

  • Services will be performed pursuant to a written Independent Contractor Agreement and applicable Statement(s) of Work.
  • Deliverables, priorities, timelines, and other engagement-specific terms will be established by mutual agreement before the applicable services begin.
  • Initial Term: The initial engagement is anticipated to continue for up to twelve (12) months. Prior to the conclusion of the initial term, EMS|MC and the contractor may mutually evaluate whether to extend the independent contractor engagement or pursue an employment opportunity, if there is mutual interest.
  • Any employment relationship would be subject to a separate offer of employment, successful completion of the Company's hiring process, and execution of all required employment documentation. Nothing in this posting or any resulting agreement guarantees future employment, continued engagement, or an extension of the initial term.


Independent Contractor Engagement

This opportunity is for the provision of professional services by an independent contractor. Nothing in this posting or any resulting agreement is intended to create an employer-employee relationship.

title: Sygeplejerske med visitationsopgaver til Lungesygdomme, sengeafsnit 1
description:
Lungesygdomme, sengeafsnit 1 på Afdeling for Medicinske Sygdomme søger sygeplejerske, 37 timer ugentligt.

I ansættelsen er der funktion som visiterende sygeplejerske.

Om afdelingen
Afdeling for Medicinske sygdomme, varetager cirka 100.000 ambulante og akutte patientforløb årligt indenfor specialerne infektionssygdomme, lungesygdomme, hormon- og stofskiftesygdomme samt ældresygdomme, med sengeafsnit og klinikker på både Herlev- og Gentofte-matriklerne. Vores seks sengeafsnit er på Herlev-matriklen.

Vi er cirka 600 medarbejdere, og har ansvar for over 200 uddannelsessøgende årligt. Vi er en særdeles aktiv afdeling indenfor forskning, og dækker flere specialer fordelt på forskellige forskningsenheder, ligesom afdelingen også huser Forskningsenheden for Klinisk Sygepleje.

Om stillingen

Stillingen veksler mellem at have funktionen som visiterende sygeplejerske og være i sengeafsnittet.

Funktion som visiterende sygeplejerske:

Den visiterende funktion deles mellem flere sygeplejersker. Funktionen er i dag - og aftenvagter.

Som visiterende sygeplejerske har du et tæt samarbejde med vores læger og Akutmodtagelsen. Der afholdes fælles flowmøder. Inden flowmøderne skal visiterende have dannet sig et overblik over ledige pladser i alle seks sengeafsnit.

Den visiterende sygeplejerske får meldt patienter til alle vores afsnit. Patienterne meldes så videre til det afsnit, hvor lægen beslutter, at patienten skal hen. Der flyttes også patienter internt dvs. mellem vores afsnit. Visiterende sørger for overlevering, hvor alle relevante oplysninger gives videre.

Målet med funktion er:

  • At sikre at patienten kommer på rette afsnit/speciale
  • At sikre ligelig fordeling af patienter mellem afsnittene
Vores profil:

På lungemedicinsk sengeafsnit modtager vi patienter med respiratoriske problemstillinger som f.eks. KOL i forværring, respiratorisk acidose, akut astma, svær pneumoni og pneumothorax, samt patienter i palliative forløb.

Vi har 28 senge og modtager største del af vores patienter fra Akutmodtagelsen.

Afdelingens vision og strategi er baseret på ”Fundamentals of Care”, derfor arbejder vi altid patientinddragende med udgangspunkt i patientens behov og oplevelser. Afdelingen har i tråd med vores vision og strategi igangsat en indsats der har til formål at sætte endnu mere fokus på sygeplejen og rammerne for at yde evidens baseres fundamental sygepleje.

Din profil:

  • Erfaren sygeplejerske (min. 2 års erfaring, gerne fra medicinsk afdeling, akutmodtagelse eller lign.)
  • Klar faglighed med sikkert blik for sygeplejens fokus
  • Venlig og imødekommende.
  • Gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner.
  • Kan prioritere og bevare ro og overblik
  • Arbejder løsningsorienteret/er på forkant
Vi tilbyder:

  • Tæt samarbejde med oversygeplejerske
  • Udvikling og supervision med den kliniske sygeplejespecialist
  • En spændende afdeling med fokus på udvikling og kvalitet
Du skal tage weekendvagt hver 3 weekend. Når du er visiterende, skal du når der ikke meldes nye patienter, deltage i sygeplejeopgaver.

For yderligere oplysninger kontakt oversygeplejerske Merete Dall på tlf. nr. 21641608 eller mail: Merete.dall@regionh.dk

Du er velkommen til at besøge os efter aftale.

Ansøgningsfrist: onsdag d. 2. september. Samtaler afholdes i uge 37.

title: TEAP Specialist/Health Instructor
description:
Primary Position Objectives

Develops and implements Trainee Employee Assistance Program, which includes assessment, intervention, counseling, relapse prevention and education. Educates and counsels on safe and healthy lifestyles.

Brief Description of Duties
  • Provides a minimum of a 1-hour interactive presentation on substance use prevention for all new students during the Career Preparation Period.
  • Schedules and conducts at least three annual center-wide substance use prevention and education activities.
  • Participates in clinical consultation with Center Director, management staff, Center Mental Health Consultant, and Health and Wellness Manager regarding substance use related prevention and education efforts for students and staff.
  • Reviews Social Intake Form (SIF) or intake assessment of all students performed by counseling staff within 1 week of arrival.
  • Collaborates with the Center Mental Health Consultant to determine when a MSWR or medical separation is appropriate and should be recommended for a student with substance use conditions.
  • Provides individual and group intervention services with a focus on behaviors that represent employability barriers.
  • Assists in developing Center operating procedures for program components related to alcohol and other drug testing and intervention.

  • Maintains liaison with community intervention resources. Evaluates self-help groups and establishes appropriate referrals.

Bachelor's Degree in related field and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Gordian is the leader in facility and construction cost data, software, and services for all phases of the building lifecycle. As the pioneer of Job Order Contracting (JOC), Gordian delivers innovative solutions including proprietary RSMeans data and Facility Intelligence tools. Our mission is to help customers maximize efficiency, optimize cost savings, and improve building quality – from planning and design to procurement, construction, and operations.

As a Project Manager at Gordian, you will play a critical role in overseeing the administrative and operational aspects of construction and facility-related projects. You will ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with customer specifications and company standards. This role requires strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, along with a solid understanding of construction processes and project management best practices.

This role supports Gordian’s partnership with the The New York City School Construction Authority (SCA) and involves managing renovation and modernization projects across school buildings in all five boroughs of NYC. This is a full-time, on-site position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Planning & Pre-Construction

  • Ensure all project prerequisites are completed, verified, and documented prior to construction start.
  • Assist in developing scopes of work, reviewing proposals, and confirming contract compliance.
  • Implement project procedures from identification through execution.
  • Perform constructability reviews during the design process and provide input to help fast-track projects.

Stakeholder Engagement & Meetings

  • Facilitate and lead key meetings, including:
    • Pre-Construction Meetings – Align scope, schedule, logistics, and safety protocols.
    • Progress Meetings – Review milestones, resolve issues, and maintain momentum.
    • Punch List Meetings – Conduct final walkthroughs to identify and close outstanding items.
  • Document and distribute meeting minutes to ensure transparency and accountability.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, contractors, and stakeholders.
  • Coordinate work with schools and SCA stakeholders to minimize disruption and ensure compliance.

Site Oversight & Quality Assurance

  • Conduct regular site visits to monitor progress, verify compliance, and ensure construction quality standards.
  • Identify and mitigate risks and delays through proactive site assessments and reporting.
  • Schedule and perform compliance inspections as required by SCA/DOE and NYC regulatory agencies.
  • Knowledge of General Construction, Mechanical and Electrical Systems, building products, construction details / design and relevant rules, regulations, and quality standards
  • Knowledge of Project estimating scheduling and cost control
  • Coordinate with plan examiners and agency representatives regarding code compliance and document requirements

Documentation & Communication

  • Review permit application documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with submission requirements
  • Review and manage comprehensive project documentation, including:
    • Project requirements
    • Schedule of values
    • Submittals and RFIs
    • Project schedules (preliminary, final, baseline updates)
    • Two-week look-aheads
    • Contractor pay applications
  • Compile and deliver final project binders for customer records.
  • Manage material take-offs from plans and specifications and review detailed construction line-item estimates and proposals.

Contract & Customer Compliance

  • Uphold customer-specific procedures and ensure alignment with contractual obligations and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide responsive support to resolve issues and maintain project continuity.
  • Review and process change orders; manage scope changes due to unforeseen conditions with proper documentation and approvals.
  • Understand compliance with NYC regulatory agencies (DOB, BEC, FDNY, DOT, DEP) for permitting, inspections, and closeout.
  • Familiar with DOB NOW and BISWEB filing systems required

Scheduling & Budget Management

  • Maintain detailed activity schedules to meet procurement and project timelines.
  • Monitor budgets and review contractor invoices in alignment with financial controls.

Risk & Safety Mitigation

  • Proactively identify potential risks and implement mitigation strategies to minimize delays, disruptions, and safety incidents.
  • Apply experience in safety and risk management to ensure compliance and maintain a secure project environment.

Change & Issue Management

  • Manage changes to project scope, schedule, or budget with proper documentation, stakeholder communication, and formal authorization.
  • Address and resolve issues or conflicts that arise during construction using negotiation and mediation skills to maintain project momentum.
  • Ensure all changes and issues are tracked, assessed for impact, and resolved efficiently to keep the project on track.

Training & Cross-Team Support

  • Train contractors on Gordian software and customer-specific procedures.
  • Support customers during contract bidding processes.
  • Facilitate communication between customers, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure alignment on goals and deliverables.

KEY SKILLS – The ideal candidate for this role will excel in the following areas.

  • Customer Obsessed – Builds strong relationships through clear communication and proactive support.
  • Collaboration – Works well with others, encourages teamwork, and values diverse input.
  • Organization – Skilled in managing project documentation and workflows with accuracy and efficiency.
  • Initiative – Takes ownership, anticipates needs, and acts without requiring direction.
  • Adaptability – Responds well to change, learns quickly, and embraces feedback.
  • Problem Solving – Thinks creatively, explores options, and resolves issues effectively.
  • Professionalism – Maintains confidentiality and always acts with integrity.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proficient in reading construction plans and specifications; experienced in comprehensive price proposal reviews.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related field; equivalent work experience may be considered.
  • 3-5+ years in construction procurement, management, or general contracting, with experience in both horizontal and vertical construction preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial public construction operations, pricing, contracting, scope development, and estimating.
  • Strong knowledge of NYC regulatory agency requirements for project filing, permitting, inspection, and closeout (DOB, FDNY, DOT, DEP).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in both planning and execution phases.
  • Exceptional communication, customer service, and teamwork skills; flexible, strategic, results-driven, and highly organized.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel); able to create custom tracking tools and reports.
  • Skilled in construction management platforms such as Procore and MS Project.
  • Experience with Job Order Contracting (JOC) or IDIQ preferred, and a solid understanding of public procurement and delivery methods.
  • Experience with Smartsheet work management software is a plus but not required.
  • Ability to travel 100% locally within the five boroughs and work primarily on-site at the NYC Long Island City office and SCA project locations.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

Ja! Vi fokuserer meget på sammenholdet og jeres oplevelse. Vi forventer, at I bidrager til det positive arbejdsmiljø og er en aktiv del af teamet.

  • Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk

title: SRE and Devops Team Manager
description:
SRE and DevOps Team Engineer | 100% Remote - India

We are seeking an experienced SRE & DevOps Manager to lead the team responsible for the reliability, automation, and scale of our SaaS platform. This is a hands-on role: you will work closely with engineering leadership to improve processes, operate incident management and on-call practices, and guide and develop a team of engineers — while remaining close enough to the systems to support the team through difficult operational challenges with credibility.

You will be accountable for the availability, performance, and operational maturity of our cloud environments, and for promoting a team culture grounded in reliability, ownership, and continuous improvement. The role coordinates day-to-day across Indian Standard Time (IST) and US time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Team leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of SRE/DevOps engineers. Work closely with engineering leadership to assess team needs and develop talent.
  • Incident management: Oversee the incident management process end to end — on-call rotations, escalation paths, incident command, postmortems, and follow-through on root cause analysis (RCA) and preventative actions.
  • Reliability practices: Define and drive SRE principles including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, capacity planning, and observability standards across services. Champion a culture of reliability and operational excellence.
  • Process improvement: Partner with engineering leadership to identify and implement process improvements across the team’s operational priorities, balancing feature delivery, reliability work, security, and cost efficiency. Guide and support the team’s day-to-day work.
  • Cross-time-zone collaboration: Coordinate a distributed team and support model across IST and US time zones, ensuring effective handoffs, coverage, and communication.
  • Leadership partnership: Interface with engineering leadership to align infrastructure investments with business and compliance goals. Report on team health, reliability metrics, and operational performance. Assist engineering leadership in managing the team, including department-wide initiatives and roadmap planning.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Leadership experience: 2-3 years of experience as a team lead or manager in a DevOps/SRE environment.
  • Distributed teams: Proven experience leading and coordinating distributed teams across time zones, specifically IST and US, including on-call coverage and handoffs.

description:
Be a part of our mission! Where is the work:

What's in it for you:

  • The Crane Operator role is responsible for supporting finished goods yard and shipping operations through the safe and efficient movement, staging, loading, unloading, and inventory handling of finished HVAC equipment and materials.
  • This role operates heavy equipment in a finished goods storage yard environment and helps ensure safety, equipment readiness, shipment support, and inventory accuracy standards are consistently maintained.
  • The position is based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, and requires regular outdoor work in varying weather conditions, including support during peak shipping periods and weather-related events.

What you will do:

  • Responsible for operating a Mi-Jack MJ100 Straddle Carrier in a safe and efficient manner within the finished goods storage yard.
  • Load and unload trailers, transport vehicles, and other designated equipment in support of shipping and yard operations.

This position requires working mainly in the Grand Rapids finished goods storage yard and outdoor logistics environment. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud. title: Mechatronics Engineer, Intern
description:
Mechatronics Engineer
Parametric — San Francisco (in-person)

About Us
Parametric is building robots to automate physical labor in the real world. We're a small team of staff-level engineers moving fast from prototype to product, and we're hiring for a fall/winter internship position.

About the Role

You’ll collaborate with our hardware engineering team to design the electrical architecture of our mobile manipulation platform: power, wiring, and the buses that tie actuators, sensors, and compute into one working robot. You'll write the bring-up and validation code for the subsystems you build and hand off clean, working interfaces to software engineers.

This is an in-person role in our San Francisco office. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

What You'll Do

  • Design electronics layout, harnessing, and cable routing for systems that move
  • Integrate actuators, sensors, and compute
  • Write bring-up, validation, and diagnostic code for the hardware you build
  • Debug electromechanical issues at the bench and on the robot
  • Work with vendors as we move toward production

What We're Looking For

  • Previous internships or club experience in robotics or electromechanical systems
  • Experience integrating motor controllers, encoders, and sensors on real hardware
  • Ability to write the code that brings hardware up and proves it works
  • Proficient at making things: CAD, 3D printing, and general fabrication
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and full ownership at an early-stage startup

The strongest applications show us what you've built. Include a portfolio, photos, or links to your work.

Parametric PBC is a public benefit corporation building robots to benefit all humans. We're a proud equal-opportunity employer and encourage applications from all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. We encourage you to apply even if you don't strictly meet all the requirements.

title: Vice President, Total Rewards and Ministry Enablement
description:
World Vision is hiring a for a Vice President of Total Rewards & Ministry Enablement to serve in the People & Culture Division.

AT A GLANCE

Role: Vice President of Total Rewards & Ministry Enablement Reports to: SVP, People & Culture Location: Remote Required Experience: Bachelor’s degree in related field. Fifteen (15) or more years of progressive leadership experience across multiple human resources disciplines, including workforce planning, total rewards, talent acquisition, HR operations, and HR technology. Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S.A for any employer. Estimated hiring range: $156,500 - $233,220

THE JOB

Provide executive leadership for workforce planning, Human Resources Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, HR Operations, and HR Information Systems. Partner with executive leaders to develop workforce strategies that enable organizational priorities, strengthen workforce effectiveness, and ensure World Vision attracts, develops, rewards, and retains mission-aligned talent. Lead the development of people strategies, systems, and services that support organizational performance, employee experience, and faithful stewardship of resources while advancing World Vision's Christian mission and values. Help carry out our Christian organization’s mission, vision, and strategies. Personify the ministry of World Vision by witnessing to Christ and ministering to others through life, deed, word and sign.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Keep Christ central in individual and corporate life. Actively participate in and contribute to the spiritual disciplines of the organization (Christian conduct, devotions, chapel, prayer, worship); incorporate WV Core Values into decisions within scope of role.
  • Develop and implement enterprise workforce planning and talent strategies that enable organizational priorities and long-term ministry effectiveness.
  • Lead the Human Resources Business Partner function to provide strategic workforce consultation and support to leaders across the organization.
  • Establish and advance total rewards strategies including compensation, benefits, executive compensation, recognition, job architecture, career frameworks, and pay governance.
  • Lead talent acquisition strategies and workforce planning efforts to attract, recruit, and retain exceptional mission-aligned talent.
  • Provide executive leadership for HR Operations and HRIS functions, ensuring effective service delivery, operational excellence, data integrity, and technology optimization.
  • Partner with executive leadership to identify workforce opportunities, solve complex organizational challenges, and lead change initiatives that strengthen organizational effectiveness.
  • Build and develop high-performing leaders and teams characterized by collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

10. Maintain awareness of corporate goals, objectives, organizational announcements, and activities. Reference and follow organizational policies and procedures, seeking clarity as needed.

YOU BRING THESE SKILLS

  • Managing Resources: Identifies appropriate people, facilities, tools and materials, time constraints, vendors, etc. for accomplishing goals. Considers potential costs and benefits of resources prior to allocating them.
  • Team Building and Group Dynamics: Applies knowledge of how teams are formed, what team competencies are, how to motivate a team, and the characteristics of high-performance teams. Recognizes and uses the strengths of team members to maximize performance.
  • Talent Management: Assesses individual and organizational skills and talent, selecting the best people to build leadership strength, and giving firm and visible support to the performance management and development of overall workforce capability.
  • Technical Expertise: Demonstrates wide knowledge and ability in one or more areas of technical expertise. Fully credible and widely respected for technical know-how.
  • Business Acumen: Applies principles of finance, accounting and business management to evaluate and quantify potential costs and benefits associated with opportunities. Objectively analyzes alternatives and recommendations appropriate for the organization.
  • Cross-Functional/Org. Understanding: Demonstrates thorough knowledge of the role and interrelationships of each organizational function. Demonstrates skill in managing across functional and organizational lines.

L.I.F.E. LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:

The LIFE Leadership Competencies provide a shared framework for Christ-centered leadership at World Vision. They define the skills, behaviors, and character qualities that help leaders lead faithfully and effectively, shaping how we hire, develop, and evaluate leaders to cultivate thriving teams and greater Kingdom impact.

  • Love: How we show up every day, every interaction. Loving others the way Jesus loves—with humility, care, and grace-filled truth. We build trust. We model life with God. And we create environments where people feel seen, valued, and supported, because we see the image of our God in each of them.
  • Ignite: How we unlock and catalyze. To Ignite is to unlock purpose, passion, and potential—so people can bring their best in service of children and donors. We build healthy, thriving teams and develop character, competence, and courage.
  • Fulfill: How We Deliver. To Fulfill is to focus on what matters most—and deliver with excellence and accountability. We own outcomes. We prioritize mission-critical work. And we partner with God to produce results that advance Kingdom impact.
  • Envision: How we change and evolve towards ‘Better’. To Envision is to lead boldly into the future—discerning what’s ahead with faith, navigating complexity, and casting vision that leads to lasting impact.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or related field.
  • Fifteen (15) or more years of progressive leadership experience across multiple human resources disciplines, including workforce planning, total rewards, talent acquisition, HR operations, and HR technology.
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale organizational initiatives, developing enterprise workforce strategies, and partnering with executive leaders in a complex organization.

SALARY & BENEFITS

title: Asset Protection Detective, Chapel Hills - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.
  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.
  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.
  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.
  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.
  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.
  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.
  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.
  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.
  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.
  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.
  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.
  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.
  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.
  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.
  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.
  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

Er du gået i stå i din karriere i Danmark, måske er det tid til at du tager på det "senere" sabbatår i udlandet?

Vi hjælper danskere med at tage til udlandet for at finde ro, livskvalitet og en anderledes hverdag.

En af vores kandidater på 64 år, med 30 års ledererfaring havde altid drømt om at arbejde i Grækenland. Han troede, det var for sent – men fra i år sidder han i kundeservice med udsigt til Middelhavet og lever sin drøm. Hans historie viser, at det aldrig er for sent at tage springet, og at erfaring og livserfaring er en styrke, som virksomheder i Sydeuropa værdsætter højt.

Hvorfor vælge udlandet som din nye start?
Du får mulighed for at opleve en ny kultur, et mildere klima og en anderledes livsstil. Du kan bruge dine eksisterende kompetencer i kundeservice, rejsebranchen eller hospitality – eller prøve noget helt nyt. Du skal have en mindre opsparing med, da du ofte først får fuld løn efter en måned. Der kan være udgifter til depositum og husleje, som skal betales ved ankomst. Vi afdækker dine kompetencer og ønsker. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til din profil. Vi forbereder dig til interviewet og sikrer, at du stiller de rigtige spørgsmål. Vi støtter dig frem til din første arbejdsdag – og videre, hvis du ønsker at udvikle dig i virksomheden.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Desenvolvimento de Materiais
description:
Descrição:

Descrição resumida


Liderar a equipe de Desenvolvimento de Materiais, assegurando a gestão técnica, estratégica e operacional dos processos de especificação, inspeção, desenvolvimento, homologação e avaliação de materiais e componentes dos sistemas metroviários. Promover soluções técnicas, inovação e melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a segurança, confiabilidade, disponibilidade e continuidade operacional dos ativos da empresa. Atuar na definição de prioridades da equipe, gestão de recursos, disseminação do conhecimento técnico, acompanhamento de indicadores e orçamento, além da gestão das interfaces com as áreas de Engenharia, Manutenção, Suprimentos, Operação, fornecedores e fabricantes.


Descrição detalhada


  • Liderar o processo de desenvolvimento de materiais, em conjunto com as Engenharias de Manutenção e demais áreas da Manutenção, identificando necessidades, riscos, oportunidades de melhoria e soluções que contribuam para a continuidade e desempenho dos ativos;
  • Desenvolver e coordenar métodos, processos e soluções técnicas de Desenvolvimento de Materiais, buscando aumento de eficiência, qualidade, confiabilidade e geração de valor para a empresa;
  • Coordenar a elaboração, revisão e disseminação dos procedimentos de Desenvolvimento de Materiais, garantindo a padronização, governança e melhoria contínua dos processos da área;
  • Elaborar proposta orçamentária de Desenvolvimento de Materiais (CAPEX e OPEX), alinhada ao planejamento estratégico da empresa, às necessidades dos ativos e às prioridades da Engenharia de Manutenção;
  • Gerir e controlar a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas com pessoal, materiais e serviços, avaliando desvios e adotando medidas para garantir o cumprimento do planejamento financeiro;
  • Estabelecer, analisar e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho de Desenvolvimento de Materiais, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos e níveis de serviço relacionados a inspeções, especificações, desenhos, desenvolvimentos e demais entregas da área, promovendo ações corretivas quando necessário;
  • Liderar, desenvolver e orientar a equipe de Desenvolvimento de Materiais, distribuindo responsabilidades, estabelecendo prioridades, acompanhando desempenho e promovendo o desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental dos profissionais;
  • Definir prioridades e alocar os recursos da equipe, considerando criticidade dos ativos, riscos operacionais, demandas da Manutenção, prazos e disponibilidade de recursos, garantindo foco nas atividades de maior impacto para o negócio;
  • Promover a gestão do conhecimento técnico da coordenação, garantindo registro, disseminação e utilização das lições aprendidas, soluções desenvolvidas, estudos realizados e informações relevantes para a continuidade dos processos e da operação;
  • Coordenar e acompanhar as atividades de inspeção, especificação, análise de desenhos/projetos e desenvolvimento de materiais, assegurando que os materiais e equipamentos adquiridos atendam aos padrões, requisitos técnicos, normas aplicáveis e expectativas operacionais da empresa;
  • Representar tecnicamente a Coordenação de Desenvolvimento de Materiais perante fornecedores, fabricantes e áreas internas, defendendo os interesses e requisitos técnicos da empresa, buscando novas soluções e conduzindo negociações e tratativas de maior complexidade;
  • Analisar e aprovar Relatórios de Conclusão de Desenvolvimento, avaliando as informações do processo, testes realizados, resultados obtidos e atendimento aos requisitos técnicos, deliberando pela aprovação ou reprovação dos materiais desenvolvidos;
  • Analisar e aprovar Relatórios Técnicos relacionados a estudos, avaliações e análises de materiais e componentes, assegurando consistência técnica e fornecendo subsídios para a tomada de decisões da Engenharia de Manutenção;
  • Gerir a interface de Desenvolvimento de Materiais com as áreas de Suprimentos, Material Rodante, Sistemas, Infraestrutura, Operação, Segurança do Trabalho, Meio Ambiente e demais áreas da empresa, promovendo integração, alinhamento de prioridades e solução de problemas;
  • Analisar e validar escopos para contratação de serviços, equipamentos e peças, assegurando que os requisitos técnicos, critérios de aceitação e demais condições necessárias estejam adequadamente definidas;
  • Validar as justificativas técnicas para aquisições junto a fornecedores exclusivos, com o apoio das engenharias de manutenção, incluindo a análise e aprovação das informações apresentadas no formulário de Justificativa de Proposta Não Concorrencial (JPNC);
  • Gerir a interface com a área de Suprimentos, acompanhando demandas, restrições e problemas relacionados ao fornecimento de materiais, promovendo ações para reduzir impactos na manutenção e assegurar os recursos necessários à realização e programação dos serviços;
  • Liderar a equipe em iniciativas de pesquisa, melhoria contínua e inovação, no desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas junto às áreas de Manutenção, buscando novos materiais, tecnologias, métodos e processos que contribuam para a evolução dos ativos e melhoria dos resultados operacionais;
  • Coordenar a interação da coordenação com as áreas de Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança pessoal, segurança sistêmica e meio ambiente sejam considerados nos processos de desenvolvimento, especificação, aquisição e aplicação dos materiais.

title: Robotics System Integration & Deployment Engineer I, Amazon Robotics International
description:
Amazon is seeking an experienced business-oriented Robotics System Integration & Deployment Engineer II to lead first-time deployments of advanced automation technologies and develop comprehensive documentation that enables global rollouts across our fulfillment network.

Join our Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation International team, where we transform complex automation technologies into efficiently deployable solutions on a global scale.

Ideal candidates will have extensive experience leading automation deployments from conception to launch, combined with strong technical problem-solving ability. You'll take complete ownership of initial deployment execution, creating comprehensive schedules, aligning cross-functional teams, vendors, and site teams, then transform initial deployment complexity into standardized, streamlined procedures for downstream teams. Working across multiple technologies will accelerate your learning through exposure to diverse stakeholders and technical environments.

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

The role requires ~40% travel across Europe during peak deployment season, with occasional international travel.

The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 7 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end deployment lifecycle from planning through go-live, managing on-site execution during Alpha and Beta phases including installation, commissioning, and validation

- Align cross-functional teams, vendors, and site teams to ensure successful project delivery

- Transform deployment complexity into scalable solutions by creating and improving comprehensive documentation and deliverables that convert initial implementations into ready-to-scale procedures

- Evaluate and deliver large-scale automation technologies including conveyance, sortation and robotics systems

- Collaborate with product, safety, deployment, quality and vendor teams throughout project lifecycle

A day in the life
You'll take complete ownership of first-time deployments, from crafting detailed project schedules to coordinating with site teams, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders. During deployment execution, you'll be on-site leading all aspects of implementation through go live.

You will interact daily with diverse functional teams across multiple time zones, conducting regular meetings with internal teams, stakeholders, and vendors. You'll build relationships with subject matter experts, analyzing the technologies we deploy. No two days will be the same in our fast-paced environment, offering opportunities for professional growth as part of a collaborative, focused team.

About the team
Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation is a diverse and multi-talented team with a proven track record of overcoming challenging technical problems to deliver Amazon’s leading-edge robotics technologies in its fulfilment, transportation, and delivery network across the world. Our high-performing team blends engineering know-how, problem solving, curiosity, innovation, leadership, and effective communication to deliver positive results for our customers.

description:
Ready to automate, innovate and make a real impact?

Do you want to build reliable, scalable systems that make a real difference to millions of people? Do you want to work at a certified B Corp with an inclusive and learning culture as part of a diverse team of great people?

If so, Opencast could be the place for you. We’re a growing tech consultancy that creates user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in government, healthcare and purpose-driven businesses. We care about building things right. We believe in good devops practices and keeping things simple. We want to support you as much as we can on interiorising our approach to devops engineering and you supporting others.

We are proud consultants who combine our own experience and approach with our company values.

We are comfortable with new tech. We are empowered, cloud native, vendor agnostic devops engineers. We are empathetic, patient and care about quality.

We know when to pick our battles and how to manage expectations. We are humble, inclusive team players that listen and collaborate, with zero egos!

We’re always willing to teach and help others (inside or outside of our team). And we’re always willing to learn.

title: Conversational Designer, APAC
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the Role

As the Founding Conversational Designer for APAC, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how Cresta delivers conversational AI solutions across the region. You’ll lead the design and deployment of best-in-class AI conversation models that power real-time coaching and assistance for contact center agents, as well as virtual agents across voice and chat experiences.

This is a highly strategic, customer-facing role that combines conversational design expertise with strong project ownership and regional influence. As one of the first hires focused on Conversation Design in APAC, you will help establish delivery best practices, scale customer impact, and serve as a key partner in expanding Cresta’s presence across international markets.

You will manage complex AI delivery engagements from initial discovery through deployment and optimization, ensuring projects stay on track, stakeholders remain aligned, and outcomes drive measurable business value.

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, Product, Project Management, and Customer Success, while acting as a trusted advisor to customers throughout implementation. You’ll also help customers design, build, and maintain their own models using Cresta Opera, our proprietary self-service platform.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end AI delivery projects across APAC, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, build, deployment, QA, and post-launch optimization
  • Serve as a founding regional expert in conversational design, helping shape scalable delivery frameworks and best practices for international customers
  • Manage multiple concurrent customer implementations while balancing timelines, priorities, and stakeholder expectations
  • Partner cross-functionally to define scope, track milestones, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution
  • Translate customer business objectives into scalable conversational AI solutions across sales, retention, collections, and customer service use cases
  • Drive alignment with customer stakeholders through regular working sessions, solution reviews, and executive-level presentations
  • Lead model maintenance and performance tuning efforts to ensure ongoing quality and measurable impact
  • Deliver Cresta’s Opera Enablement Program to key stakeholders, empowering customers to independently design, build, and QA their own AI models
  • Design and develop virtual agent solutions using flow-based, prompt-based, and hybrid architectures
  • Contribute to internal documentation, implementation standards, and repeatable delivery methodologies as Cresta scales globally
  • Partner closely with teams in North America while helping establish regional expertise and customer success across APAC

Qualifications We Value

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including managing multiple complex workstreams simultaneously
  • Proven ability to independently own deliverables, timelines, and cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced environment
  • 2+ years of experience in conversational design, conversational AI, bot development, or related fields
  • Experience presenting complex solutions to enterprise customer stakeholders, including executive audiences
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers in implementation, consulting, or delivery roles
  • Experience operating in global or international customer environments preferred
  • Fluency in a second language strongly preferred
  • Background in Linguistics preferred
  • Experience with prompt engineering preferred
  • Experience with Dialogflow CX preferred

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • 20 days of vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Total compensation includes Base + Bonus + Equity, along with a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

title: Job på Cypern - Kundeservicemedarbejdere til digitalisering - Betalt firmabolig - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Kundeservicemedarbejdere til digitalisering på Cypern – Opstart den 7. september!

Er du klar til at tage springet og starte et nyt eventyr? Vi søger dansktalende kundeservicemedarbejdere til vores team på solrige Cypern – og ja, flyttepakke er inkluderet!

Drømmer du om at bo i et af Europas mest solrige lande og samtidig opbygge både personlig og professionel erfaring? Så er denne mulighed skræddersyet til dig!

Vi ved, at det kan være en stor beslutning at flytte til udlandet. Derfor sørger vi for at hjælpe dig med hele processen. Vi tilbyder en omfattende flyttepakke, der inkluderer kompensation for din flyrejse og hjælp til at finde bolig. Derudover assisterer vi med administrative opgaver som kontakt til lokale myndigheder og åbning af bankkonto. På vores kontor i Cypern vil du blive mødt af engagerede og støttende kollegaer, som beskriver sig selv som en "Cypern-familie." Kontoret emmer af fællesskab, og der er altid plads til sociale aktiviteter – både i og udenfor arbejdstiden.

Med denne oplevelse vil du ikke blot udvikle dine kompetencer, men også skabe minder for livet.

Om Rollen:

I rollen som kundeservicemedarbejder bliver dine primære opgaver at besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon og e-mail, finde løsninger på deres udfordringer og sikre en førsteklasses kundeoplevelse.

Vores kundeservice har åbent mandag-fredag kl. 9:00-21:00 samt lørdag-søndag kl. 11:00-17:00 (lokal tid i Cypern) Du vil have vagter både om dagen, om aftenen og i weekenden. Du starter med et betalt træningsforløb, hvor du får indblik i de tekniske aspekter af arbejdet og lærer, hvordan du leverer enestående kundeservice.

Dine daglige opgaver inkluderer:

  • Håndtering af kundeopkald

  • Sikring af fremragende kundeservice

  • Administration af kundesager

  • Arbejde mod dine KPI'er inden for kundetilfredshed, effektivitet og kvalitet

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er social, hjælpsom og drevet af at levere god service

  • Trives i et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø med stærkt fællesskab

  • Har afsluttet gymnasiet, taler og forstår dansk, kan engelsk

Fordele ved jobbet:

  • Konkurrencedygtig månedsløn og bonusordning

  • 330 solskinsdage om året

  • Skattefordele med 0% indkomstskat op til €19.500 årligt

  • Forsikring mod sygdom og ulykker både på arbejdet og i fritiden

  • Rabatter på lokale caféer, restauranter og fitnesscentre

  • Flyttepakke med bolig og dækning af rejseudgifter

  • 21 dages ferie om året

  • Hjælp til at håndtere praktiske opgaver som bankoprettelse og migrationspapirer

Vores moderne kontor i Larnaca har ca. 650 kollegaer og en varm og inkluderende atmosfære. Her møder du medarbejdere fra Danmark, Sverige, Norge, Finland, Tyskland og England.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Send din ansøgning i dag og bliv en del af vores spændende team på Cypern!

Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique
At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location - Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will play a key role in building and implementing features that empower lodging customers to make data-driven pricing decisions. Some of these features will use simple heuristic data, while others will leverage advanced machine learning techniques to optimize revenue strategies.

You’ll work closely with product and engineering teams to identify opportunities for improvement, develop innovative solutions, and drive revenue growth for the hotels that rely on our platform. Your impact will be focused on ensuring the reliability, scalability, and high quality of our ML systems from development to production. You’ll be instrumental in establishing robust ML practices and rigorous testing processes across the entire ML lifecycle. From structuring data pipelines to implementing and validating ML models, you’ll own the end-to-end development of our revenue management application—ensuring hotels have the reliable, accurate insights they need to maximize their success.

Our Machine Learning Team:

Our machine learning team is energized by the unique challenge of revolutionizing guest experiences through AI-driven insights, transforming traditional hospitality with cutting-edge predictive algorithms.

We thrive on collaborative innovation, where data scientists, engineers, and product experts seamlessly blend their expertise to prototype bold ideas and directly impact operational efficiency.

People who are passionate about continuous learning, unafraid to challenge conventions, and excited by the intersection of hospitality and deep technical prowess will find their home among our forward-thinking team.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Architectural Expertise: Proven track record in designing, deploying, and maintaining production-grade, distributed ML systems (Sagemaker)
  • Deep MLOps Proficiency: Expert-level knowledge of CI/CD, orchestration (e.g., Apache Airflow, Flink), and model monitoring/drift detection at scale.
  • Software Engineering Rigor: Strong background in Python, distributed systems, and backend development, with a firm grasp of software engineering best practices.
  • Technical Strategy: Experience defining SLIs/SLOs and managing large-scale technical roadmaps.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, mentor junior talent, and drive consensus on complex technical decisions.
  • Domain Knowledge: Ability to apply statistical and ML methods to optimize revenue management and pricing strategies.

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of experience in a machine learning role, with demonstrated success in ML Engineering and deploying models to production.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing ML testing strategies (e.g., data validation, model correctness, performance testing).
  • Great understanding of machine learning principles (experimental design, statistical distributions and test, machine learning algorithms)
  • Expertise in deploying ML models at scale on AWS, with experience using MLFlow, Sagemaker or similar platforms.
  • Strong Python programming skills and adherence to software engineering best practices (e.g., clean code, version control, code reviews, using Docker, Terform, Kubernetes).
  • Expert-level SQL skills and experience working with large datasets for analysis and modeling.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to apply creative, data-driven solutions to complex business challenges.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

Bonus Skills to Stand Out (Optional):

  • Experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins) specifically for ML pipelines and Airflow DAG deployment.
  • Experience with data quality monitoring tools and frameworks.
  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.

Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. description:
Sr/Principal Statistician (Sponsor-dedicated) Many possible locations (EMEA) - Early Phase

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provides support across all assigned statistical tasks during the lifecycle of the project, from protocol to CSR.
  • Prepares Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), including development of well-presented mock-up displays for tables, listings, and figures. Collaborate with the sponsor, if required.
  • May be responsible for the statistical aspects of the protocol, generation of randomization schedule, publications and input to the clinical study report.
  • Coordinates the activities of other biostatistics and statistical programming personnel on assigned projects to ensure timely completion of high quality work. Provides independent review of project work produced by other biostatisticians in the department.
  • Creates or reviews programming specifications for analysis datasets, tables, listings, and figures.
  • Reviews SAS annotated case report forms (CRFs), database design, and other study documentation to ensure protocol criteria are met and all data is captured as required to support a high quality database and the planned analysis.
  • Conducts and participates in verification and quality control of project deliverables, ensuring that output meets expectations and is consistent with analysis described in SAP and specifications.
  • Implements company objectives, and create alternative solutions to address business and operational challenges.
  • Serves as biostatistics representative on project teams, interfacing as necessary with other departmental project team representatives. This would include preparing in advance for internal meetings, contributing ideas, and demonstrating respect for opinions of others.
  • Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects, sets goals based on priorities from management, adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload, and proactively communicates to biostatistics management any difficulties with meeting these timelines.
  • Monitors progress on study activities against agreed upon milestones and ensures the study timelines for project deliverables are met. Identifies out of scope tasks and escalate to management.
  • Provides statistical programming support as needed.
  • May participate in Data Safety Monitoring Board and/or Data Monitoring Committee activities, including charter development and serving as an independent non-voting biostatistician.
  • May lead projects involving integrated analyses, attend regulatory agency meetings or respond to questions, as needed, to support the statistical analysis results of clinical trials on behalf of the sponsor.
  • Follows applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).
  • Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, and verification/quality control documents and programs; ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Displays willingness to work with others and assists with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business.
  • Supports business development activities by contributing to proposals, budgets, and attending sponsor bid defense meetings.
  • Coaches and mentors other Biostatistics staff.
  • Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
  • Minimal travel may be required.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. title: Recoveries Claims Specialist
description:

The Recoveries Claims Specialist provides operational and technical support to the Chubb Recoveries Team, ensuring all activities are carried out in line with Chubb’s compliance and regulatory requirements.   • Recoveries Team, Management and Referring Claim Office.

  • Effectively communicate with the following:
  • Claim Department, Customer Services, Risk Control, Underwriting Departments, brokers, insureds, counsel, third parties and/or their legal representatives.
  • Adhere to Insurance Contracts Act and all other relevant statutory rules and regulations.
  • Effectively control the use, work product and expense of outside vendors.
  • Any other duties as required by the Recoveries Claims Manager.
  • Accountable for taking all practical measures to ensure that the workplace is safe and without risk to health.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • In-depth knowledge of the insurance industry and international insurance business
  • Good negotiation skills.
  • Good understanding of recovery analytics systems (desirable)
  • Analytical thinking and good numerical understanding.
  • Responsibility to develop, implement and achieve ambitious goals.
  • Written and verbal communication related to recovery claims handling.
  • Ability to lead the department on recovery through motivation and assertiveness.
  • Experience in dealing with international matrix structures and corresponding decision-making processes (desirable).
