title: P & A Forecaster
description:
Come and join the Trek Family, where you will help make only products we love, provide incredible hospitality to our customers, and change the world by getting more people on bikes.

Are you ready to step into a role as a P&A Forecaster for the Asia Pacific (APAC) business?

A Bit About Us

At Trek, we're on a mission to change the world by getting more people on bikes. As the leading global manufacturer, distributor, retailer, and wholesaler of cycling products, we focus on solving real-world problems like urban congestion, pollution, obesity, and mental health issues through the power of cycling.

We’re a family owned, values-driven company that’s committed to professional development, putting the best team on the field, and having a blast while doing it. We care about our people, our products, and the communities we serve.

Why Trek?

Because we believe in offering more than just a job – we offer a career where you’re valued, supported, and given endless opportunities to grow professionally.

Ideally the role will be based from our Australian Support Office but remote arrangements will be considered for the right candidate.

About the Role

As P&A Forecaster you will work closely with the APAC P&A Forecast Manager:

Demand Planning & Forecasting

  • Maintain monthly cadence of reviewing and generating forecasts and requisite order submission
  • Enter orders into Trek ERP platform and submit orders to vendor
  • Maintain accurate delivery dates in ERP Platform
  • Upload delivery schedules when vendors submit monthly production updates.
  • Submit monthly forecast updates to suppliers, US Forecasters and / or product teams.
  • Work closely with retail purchasing teams to ensure strong alignment between wholesale and retail range/purchasing plans

Customer Engagement and Communication

  • Seek feedback from local markets regarding initial forecasts for new products
  • Communicate major delays / issues to sales, marketing, and / or retail purchasing team.
  • Collect feedback from local market teams regarding new and existing product and report back to product teams.
  • Provide feedback on potential new products to US Product team.
  • Collaborate and challenge suppliers to optimize inbound product flow, balancing availability and cost

Continuous Improvement of Forecasting/Purchasing process

  • Identify process gaps and lead continuous improvement initiatives in forecasting tools, workflows, and analysis.
  • Provide ad-hoc analysis and scenario modelling to support strategic decision-making.

Why You’ll Love Working at Trek

  • Join a Global Brand – It’s more than just a role; it’s about being part of something bigger.
  • Ride Our Bikes – We encourage our team to get on the bikes so you know our products with our Employee purchase benefits.

What We’re Looking For

We are on the lookout for someone to join our team with:

  • Bachelor degree in Business, Supply Chain, Commerce or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in demand planning, inventory management or commercial forecasting within consumer goods, cycling or sporting goods is beneficial but not required.
  • Experience working with parts, accessories or aftermarket product categories is highly advantageous.
  • Advanced data skills; experience with planning or ERP systems
  • Curiosity about and experience with AI tools applied to forecasting, demand planning or data analysis; comfortable exploring generative AI to improve accuracy, automate workflows and accelerate decision-making.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data sets and communicate findings clearly. Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills; comfortable influencing across functions and geographies.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Values aligned with Trek: hospitality, empathy, curiosity and a passion for cycling.
  • Willingness to work across time zones to collaborate with global and regional teams.
  • An excellent listener who cultivates strong relationships across different markets, functions and cultures
  • Have a learn-it-all mindset. The bike industry is constantly evolving and staying abreast of current trends is critical.

Ready to Ride with Us?

If you’re driven, passionate, and ready to lead, we want YOU on our team. Apply now and join the Trek Family today! Let’s build something amazing together. We ask that you provide a cover letter.

Learn more about us here:

Trek is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

title: Consultant Strategie & Innovatie
description:
De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als Consultant Strategie & Innovatie

Strategie vertalen naar concrete beweging in de energietransitie. Dat doe jij als Consultant Strategie & Innovatie. Je werkt aan initiatieven die bijdragen aan het beter benutten van het elektriciteitsnet en helpt deze verder te brengen van idee naar uitvoerbare aanpak. Daarbij kijk je verder dan één team of afdeling: je overziet de bredere keten, verbindt belangen en zorgt dat plannen worden door vertaald naar duidelijke keuzes, acties en resultaten. Je werkt aan uitbreiding van bestaande dienstverlening met partners in de energietransitie. Jij brengt structuur, overzicht en voortgang in complexe initiatieven. Je schakelt makkelijk met interne specialisten, externe stakeholders en sectorpartijen. Waar nodig neem je het initiatief, organiseer je besluitvorming en help je teams om van ambitie naar realisatie te komen.

Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. En als Consultant Strategie & Innovatie werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben jij bezig met het:

  • verder brengen van strategische initiatieven binnen Alliander en de sector, zodat ideeën worden vertaald naar concrete keuzes, acties en resultaten.
  • managen van initiatieven in de bredere keten, waarbij je afhankelijkheden, belangen en voortgang scherp houdt.
  • verbinden van interne en externe stakeholders om draagvlak, samenwerking en versnelling te organiseren.
  • sturen op het sector- en ketenportfolio én het op het juiste moment kunnen versnellen op verschillende onderwerpen.
  • vakinhoudelijk adviseren van de organisatie en externe stakeholders over de ontwikkeling en realisatie van veranderbewegingen.
  • aansturen van IT- en business teams om van plannen naar geïmplementeerde oplossingen te komen.

Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander

Wist je dat Alliander bestaat uit verschillende bedrijven die samen werken aan een betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig energienet? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers in Nederland. Alles wat we doen, doen we met oog voor de mensen die op ons rekenen: onze klanten. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken we de energietransitie mogelijk, voor en mét onze klanten

En jij gaat dat doen bij ons bedrijfsonderdeel Liander. Hier werk jij aan het beheer, onderhoud of de aanleg van onze elektriciteits- en gasnetten. Veiligheid staat bij ons altijd voorop: jij zorgt voor veiligheid in je dagelijkse werk en wij zorgen dat je daarbij wordt ondersteund. Zo leveren wij op een veilige en betrouwbare manier energie aan huishoudens, bedrijven en onze andere klanten.

title: Robotics Systems Engineer I, Tech Deployment
description:
Join Amazon's Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy innovative industrial robotics across North America's fulfillment network. In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology & Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end-to-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.

- You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
- You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
- You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
- You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources
- You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
- You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
- You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
- You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
- You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results




A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

description:

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

What's in it for you:
Trane Technologies is seeking an API Technical Lead who will play a critical role in enabling reliable, secure, and scalable API solutions across our global technology ecosystem. This position sits at the center of enterprise connectivity, ensuring seamless integration and communication between cloud platforms, enterprise applications, digital products, middleware solutions, and business-critical systems.

As an API Technical Lead, you will work with modern API management platforms, integration technologies, and event-driven architectures to build and support resilient, high-performing, and reusable API services that enable business growth and digital transformation. You will collaborate with architects, application teams, infrastructure teams, and business partners to deliver API platform solutions that are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards and best practices.

This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex API and platform engineering challenges, improving operational reliability, and driving innovation across a diverse technology landscape. You will gain exposure to enterprise-scale API ecosystems while contributing to the modernization and continuous evolution of our API platforms.

What you will do:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in API design, development, and enterprise integration delivery.
  • Strong experience in designing, developing, securing, and managing APIs across on-premises, SaaS, cloud, and hybrid ecosystems.
  • Proven expertise in end-to-end API lifecycle delivery, including planning, design, development, testing, deployment, publishing, and support of enterprise APIs.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Google Apigee API Management/Gateway, including API proxy development, shared flows, traffic management, analytics, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong understanding of API security concepts and implementation, including authentication, authorization, OAuth 2.0, token-based security, throttling, rate limiting, and secure service exposure.
  • Experience developing and testing API proxies, reusable shared flows, and custom policies using JavaScript, Java, Node.js, Python, and related technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of API design patterns, RESTful architecture principles, and enterprise API best practices.
  • Experience implementing advanced API management capabilities such as logging, caching, request/response transformation, custom analytics, monitoring, throttling, and performance optimization.
  • Strong understanding of API standards and integration technologies, including OpenAPI 3.0, Swagger, REST, SOAP, JSON, messaging, microservices, and distributed integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience designing stateless distributed architectures with strong focus on scalability, resiliency, performance, and maintainability.
  • Experience analyzing, documenting, and improving key API platform capabilities such as API catalogs, developer enablement, monitoring, observability, and analytics.
  • Good understanding of DevSecOps best practices, with exposure to source control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation using GitHub and GitHub Actions.
  • Ability to create architecture diagrams, solution flows, and technical documentation using Visio or similar tools to communicate API and integration designs effectively.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to champion API best practices, continuous improvement, standardization, and knowledge sharing across large-scale enterprise initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence and innovation by promoting reusable patterns, scalable API architecture, and modern platform engineering practices.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical work experience.
  • Proven experience as an API Platform Engineer, Integration Engineer, or similar role, with 7–10 years of experience in a development, engineering, or technical lead capacity.
  • Strong experience in designing, developing, securing, and managing APIs across on-premises, SaaS, cloud, and hybrid ecosystems.
  • Proven expertise in end-to-end API lifecycle delivery, including planning, design, development, testing, deployment, publishing, and support of enterprise APIs.
  • Solid understanding of API platform engineering, API gateways, API management, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience implementing scalable, secure, and reusable API solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, API security, authentication and authorization mechanisms, and service governance.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including architects, developers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

The Identity Management Engineer / Architect designs, implements, and operates a secure, scalable enterprise identity platform spanning on-premises, cloud, SaaS, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for automated identity provisioning and deprovisioning, strong authentication, least-privilege access, modern application federation, privileged account management, and continuous identity governance, monitoring, and auditing.

This position is foundational to the Zero Trust identity pillar and ensures that users, administrators, applications, and workloads receive appropriate access based on verified identity, policy, risk, and mission requirements. The engineer/architect will support government and regulated environments through PIV/CAC smart-card authentication, phishing-resistant MFA, FICAM-aligned identity practices, privileged-access controls, and secure integration across enterprise identity platforms.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and operate enterprise IAM / ICAM architectures supporting on-premises, cloud, SaaS, and hybrid environments.
  • Engineer and maintain directory services, including Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID where included in the approved architecture.
  • Design and automate user provisioning, deprovisioning, role assignment, access changes, and identity lifecycle management processes.
  • Integrate enterprise applications using modern identity and federation standards including SAML, OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth, and SCIM.
  • Implement and maintain Privileged Access Management (PAM) controls for administrative, elevated, and high-risk accounts.
  • Design and operate Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) capabilities using SailPoint or approved enterprise identity-governance platforms.
  • Integrate and administer AWS IAM Identity Center and related AWS identity and access-management capabilities.
  • Implement PIV/CAC smart-card authentication, certificate-based authentication, and other approved strong-authentication mechanisms.
  • Enforce phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication for privileged and mission-critical access.
  • Align identity architectures, authentication methods, credential lifecycle processes, and access controls with FICAMrequirements and applicable government identity standards.
  • Develop and enforce least-privilege, role-based, and policy-based access controls across enterprise systems and applications.
  • Automate identity-management processes using scripting, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, and workflow technologies.
  • Integrate PAM, IGA, directory, cloud identity, and authentication platforms to provide consistent identity controls across environments.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, auditing, and alerting for authentication events, privileged activity, identity lifecycle changes, and access-policy violations.
  • Perform periodic access reviews, entitlement analysis, privileged-account reviews, and identity-governance activities.
  • Partner with application, cloud, cybersecurity, platform, and DevSecOps teams to securely onboard applications and services into enterprise identity platforms.
  • Troubleshoot complex authentication, federation, provisioning, directory synchronization, authorization, and access-management issues.
  • Maintain identity architecture documentation, integration standards, operational procedures, access-control models, and governance processes.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, engineering, or administering enterprise IAM / ICAM solutions.
  • Strong experience with Active Directory and cloud-based directory services such as Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Hands-on experience with identity federation and provisioning standards including SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM.
  • Experience implementing or operating Privileged Access Management platforms and privileged identity workflows.
  • Experience with Identity Governance and Administration, preferably using SailPoint IdentityIQ or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud.
  • Experience with AWS IAM, AWS IAM Identity Center, and cloud identity integration.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, RBAC, ABAC, least privilege, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Experience implementing PIV/CAC, certificate-based authentication, and phishing-resistant MFA.
  • Familiarity with FICAM, federal identity standards, and authentication requirements for government environments.
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust architecture, with particular emphasis on identity as a primary policy-enforcement and access-control pillar.
  • Experience automating identity workflows using APIs, scripting languages, PowerShell, Python, Terraform, or comparable automation technologies.
  • Experience integrating identity platforms with SaaS applications, cloud services, enterprise applications, and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Experience with centralized logging, identity monitoring, audit reporting, access reviews, and compliance evidence collection.
  • Experience supporting government, defense, GovCloud, or other regulated environments is preferred.
  • Strong architecture, troubleshooting, documentation, governance, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

    • Preferred Certifications:

    • AWS Certified Security – Specialty
    • Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
    • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100)
    • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
    • SailPoint IdentityIQ / Identity Security Cloud certification
    • CyberArk Defender or CyberArk Sentry

title: Autism Outreach Service Practitioner
description:
Organisation: Leicestershire County Council

Work Location: County Hall, Glenfield, Leicester LE3 8RA

Salary: £28,605 - £31,029 per annum (pro-rata for part-time) (Pay award pending)

Working Hours: 22.2 hours Term time - 3 days per week

Contract Type: Permanent

Closing Date: 13th September 2026

Interview Date(s): 23rd September 2026 -in person

About the Role

The Autism Outreach Team has an exciting and interesting opportunity for an enthusiastic and committed specialist practitioner to join the Team.

The Autism Outreach Team is a well-regarded and welcoming team, consisting of specialist teachers and practitioners with a wealth of knowledge and experience and a passion for Inclusion. We work with mainstream education settings across Leicestershire to support positive outcomes for autistic pupils in Key Stages 1-5.

We are committed to understanding autism as difference rather than deficit and as part of Specialist Teaching Service, we aim to improve opportunities, outcomes and experiences for children and young people with SEND in partnership with families, educational settings and organisations.

The successful applicant will have casework responsibility, under the supervision and support of a specialist teacher, which will focus on enabling schools to implement a range of teaching and learning strategies to support the progress and inclusion of pupils with a diagnosis of autism or communication and interaction needs. You will provide support for educational settings through coaching, modelling of good practice, sharing knowledge, approaches, and resources as well as contributing to the APDR cycle of support.

The role involves maintaining thorough records of work undertaken and contributing to Education, Health and Care Plan assessments and annual reviews, when appropriate. In addition, you will engage with ongoing professional development to identify, develop and deliver resources that promote curriculum access for autistic learners.

An enhanced with barred list DBS check is required for this post.

For information on our approach to the recruitment of ex-offenders, please see our policy statement.

About You

To apply for this post, you must:

  • NVQ 3 level qualification or equivalent in a study related to the role, with evidence of further training and development in Special Educational Needs and Disabilities.
  • Substantial experience of working directly with pupils with a diagnosis of Autism or communication and interaction needs, including knowledge of effective teaching and learning approaches and resources to support the attainment and inclusion of autistic pupils
  • Good interpersonal skills, with the ability to relate positively to children, young people, parents and other professionals and establish effective working relationships with colleagues, educational settings and partner agencies
  • Ability to manage a caseload effectively, prioritise work and demonstrate effective time management, using own initiative to plan and work in an organised manner
  • Significant experience of working appropriately in accordance with relevant statutory and local policies and procedures for SEND and the ability to carry out all duties in line with LCC Safeguarding policies and procedures and fulfil relevant safeguarding competencies
  • Ability to actively demonstrate the values of the authority: Positivity; Trust and respect; Flexibility; Openness and Transparency
  • Must be able to perform all duties and tasks with reasonable adjustment, where appropriate, in accordance with the provisions of the Equality Act 2010. This will include requirements to work flexibly around holiday periods in line with the service requirements and access to a vehicle with the ability to travel to temporary bases such as schools, touch-down bases etc

in addition, we also expect you to share our commitment to our values and to delivering accessible and inclusive services which meet the needs of all of our residents. You will be asked to demonstrate your understanding of these commitments as part of the selection process.

Reasonable adjustments will be considered for applicants with a disability. We are a Disability Confident Employer.

Interested in Flexible Working?

We are open to discussions about flexible working, which may include part time working, job sharing, term-time working, flexible start and finish times, and hybrid working, depending on the requirements of the role and the service. If you would like to discuss the possible flexible working options that might be applicable to this role, please contact the person named below.

For more information or an informal discussion, please contact:

Angela Shipley, Autism Outreach Team Manager

Telephone: 0116 3050673

Email: angela.shipley@leics.gov.uk

How to Apply

At Leicestershire County Council we’re looking for top talent from all walks of life. Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, and whatever your background - we care about what you bring to our organisation, not just what’s on your CV. That’s why we’ve designed a recruitment process that’s fair, accessible, and focused on potential. And with benefits that support people at every age and stage of life, we make sure you can thrive - both personally and professionally.

If you share our passion to make a difference for the people of Leicestershire, we’d love to hear from you. Click the apply button to submit your application, ensuring that you upload a supporting statement that explains how you meet the criteria listed in the ‘About You’ section above. Without this information, we won’t be able to assess your suitability for the role, and your application will be rejected. For tips on how to write your statement, see the How to Apply section on our career site.

description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

As a Member Services Guide (MSG) OR a Member Outreach Specialist (MOS) at Devoted Health, you will be a primary point of connection for our members, meeting them where they are, understanding what they need, and helping them navigate the complexities of healthcare with empathy, accuracy, and care.

Guides at Devoted work across a range of member-facing functions. Depending on where you are placed - Member Service Guide OR Member Outreach Specialist, your home base may focus on inbound service — responding to member questions, resolving benefit issues, and supporting care navigation in real time — OR on proactive outreach, connecting members with clinical programs, scheduling care, and helping them get ahead of their health needs. Regardless of your primary focus, every Guide is expected to flex across both inbound and outbound work as business needs evolve. That flexibility isn’t a nice-to-have — it’s core to how this team operates and how we serve members well.

In every interaction — whether voice, video, SMS, chat, or digital messaging — you’ll bring our mission to life: treating every member like family. You’ll do this by actively listening, anticipating needs, breaking down complex information into clear and actionable guidance, and working alongside our AI Guide Assistant, a real-time tool designed to help you access information instantly so you can stay fully present and focused on the member.

Responsibilities and impact:

  • Member Engagement and Support:

    • Engage with members across all channels (voice, digital, SMS, chat, video) with deep empathy, professionalism, and care.

    • Help members navigate benefits, find providers, schedule appointments, and translate complex healthcare information into clear, actionable terms.

    • Conduct proactive clinical outreach, effectively identifying escalation paths and collaborating with clinical staff.

  • Operational Excellence:

    • Leverage data, internal systems, and an AI Guide Assistant to deliver fast, accurate, and fully documented solutions.

    • Adhere strictly to HIPAA guidelines, compliance regulations, and internal workflows.

    • Meet established productivity, quality, and output performance metrics and standards.

  • Flexibility and Growth:

    • Flex between inbound, outbound, and cross-functional programs as seasonal business priorities evolve.

    • Adapt quickly to process, workflow, and technology updates with a solutions-oriented attitude.

    • Actively apply real-time feedback and coaching from peers and leadership to drive personal growth.

Required skills and experience:

  • 1+ years of experience in a high-volume customer-facing role or fast-paced healthcare environment, with a proven track record of building trust and professional relationships.

  • Professional fluency in both English and Spanish — written and oral — is required. You will serve both English and Spanish speaking members.

  • Genuine passion for improving the healthcare experience: you love to serve, you care deeply about people, and making a difference motivates you.

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule based on business needs, including potential seasonal adjustments.

  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills and high emotional intelligence: the ability to adapt your tone to any situation, and a natural gift for making people feel heard.

  • Ability to de-escalate intense or emotionally charged interactions with empathy and composure, and to translate complex information into simple, actionable terms.

  • Comfort working alongside AI-powered tools and digital platforms to streamline tasks and enhance the quality of member service.

  • Flexibility and adaptability: you pivot quickly between priorities, operate effectively in gray areas, and embrace frequent process changes with a positive attitude.

  • Strong multitasking ability: you can listen, talk, and type simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and presence.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience in a contact center or call center environment.

  • Experience in healthcare, health insurance, or Medicare Advantage — familiarity with benefits, scheduling, and medical terminology is a plus.

  • Experience working in highly regulated environments, ideally with HIPAA guidelines and requirements.

  • Proven ability to navigate multiple software platforms simultaneously while maintaining composure and accuracy.

  • Experience using effective stress management techniques to maintain professionalism in emotionally demanding situations.

  • A track record of applying feedback quickly and demonstrating visible growth in response to coaching.

title: OS Image Factory Engineer (R-00195)
description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

The OS Image Factory Engineer designs, builds, and maintains a standardized image factory that produces secure, repeatable, and version-controlled operating system and container images for enterprise and government environments. The role is responsible for delivering STIG-hardened RHEL, Windows, and container images through fully automated CI/CD pipelines with integrated security scanning, policy enforcement, validation, artifact management, and lifecycle controls.

This position ensures that images are consistently built, tested, signed, promoted, maintained, and retired using approved engineering and governance processes. The engineer will support AWS GovCloud and Zero Trust requirements by incorporating DISA STIG hardening, OpenSCAP validation, FIPS-enabled configurations, image signing, and software supply chain attestation into the image creation process.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain standardized OS images for RHEL and Windows environments.
  • Develop and manage container image build, validation, promotion, and lifecycle processes.
  • Build automated image pipelines using EC2 Image Builder and/or HashiCorp Packer.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate image creation, testing, security validation, approval, promotion, and retirement.
  • Use Ansible for configuration management, operating system hardening, software installation, and repeatable image configuration.
  • Integrate vulnerability scanning and security assessment tools into image build and release pipelines.
  • Implement and maintain DISA STIG-hardened configurations for supported operating systems and validate compliance using OpenSCAP or equivalent approved tooling.
  • Produce and maintain FIPS-enabled builds where required by system and security requirements.
  • Implement image signing and attestation to support Zero Trust software supply chain integrity and verification.
  • Manage image artifacts, versions, metadata, dependencies, and retention policies within approved artifact registries and repositories.
  • Establish lifecycle processes for image creation, testing, release, patching, deprecation, and retirement.
  • Enforce image governance standards, release controls, approval workflows, and configuration baselines.
  • Maintain traceability between source configuration, build pipelines, security results, image versions, and released artifacts.
  • Partner with platform, cloud, cybersecurity, and application teams to ensure image standards meet operational, compliance, and deployment requirements.
  • Develop automated tests to verify image functionality, configuration, security posture, and readiness prior to release.
  • Maintain technical documentation, build standards, operating procedures, and image-factory governance processes.
  • Continuously improve image build times, reliability, repeatability, security controls, and pipeline automation.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience with OS image engineering for RHEL and Windows platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with container image creation, management, scanning, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience using EC2 Image Builder, HashiCorp Packer, or comparable image automation technologies.
  • Strong experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure or system artifacts.
  • Hands-on experience with Ansible configuration management and automation.
  • Experience integrating vulnerability scanning, compliance validation, and security policy enforcement into automated pipelines.
  • Experience implementing DISA STIG hardening and performing compliance validation using OpenSCAP or comparable technologies.
  • Understanding of FIPS-enabled operating system and application configurations.
  • Experience implementing image signing, provenance, integrity validation, and attestation within a software supply chain.
  • Experience managing artifact repositories, container registries, image versions, retention policies, and artifact promotion workflows.
  • Strong understanding of configuration management, version control, release management, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Experience operating in AWS GovCloud, government, defense, or other regulated cloud environments is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles, particularly software supply chain integrity, trusted artifacts, and continuous verification.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, governance, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

    • Preferred Certifications:

    • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)
    • Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers
    • Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation
    • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
    • Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate
We’re actively searching for talented security and technology practitioners who are ready to experience the True Zero difference. As a True Zero team member, you'll enjoy:

title: Transformation Project Manager
description:
Job Description

Purpose of Role

The Transformation Project Manager is responsible for leading the successful delivery of ISP's outsourcing programme and the creation of a multi-site global shared service centre operation with the main hub located in India. Reporting to Group Head of Transformation, Change and Onboarding the role will oversee the end-to-end transition of services from existing operating models to our selected outsourcing partner, ensuring delivery is achieved on time, within budget, and with minimal disruption to business operations.

The Project Manager will coordinate multiple workstreams across HR, Finance, Technology, Procurement, and Operations, driving transition execution, stakeholder engagement, governance, risk management, change management, and operational readiness. The role will act as the central point of accountability for programme delivery and benefits realisation throughout transition and stabilisation.

The successful candidate will bring significant experience leading large-scale outsourcing transitions, with particular expertise in HR and Finance service migrations to India and other spoke locations and managing complex organisational change within multinational businesses.

Transformation Programme Manager Key Responsibilities

Programme Delivery and Transition Management

  • Lead the delivery of the HR and Finance outsourcing transition programme.

  • Manage programme plans, milestones, interdependencies, risks, issues, and budgets.

  • Drive delivery across all transition workstreams to ensure successful migration of services to India and other spoke locations.

  • Coordinate activities between ISP teams and the outsourcing partner and hold both stakeholder parties to account for delivery timelines and go-live readiness.

  • Track programme progress and provide regular reporting to the Head of Transformation and Steering Committee.

  • Ensure key transition deliverables are completed in line with agreed timelines and quality standards.

Transition Execution & Service Migration

  • Lead transition planning and execution across HR and Finance processes.

  • Oversee knowledge transfer activities between retained teams and outsourced service teams.

  • Ensure process documentation, controls, and operating procedures are effectively transitioned.

  • Manage cutover planning, business readiness, and go-live activities.

  • Drive issue resolution during migration and stabilisation phases.

  • Ensure effective handover into business-as-usual operations.

Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership

  • Develop and execute stakeholder engagement and change management plans in collaboration with internal and outsourcing change management teams.

  • Build strong relationships with senior business leaders and functional teams.

  • Support leaders through organisational change and operating model transformation.

  • Liaise with communications team to ensure consistency and alignment in messaging.

  • Identify and mitigate organisational resistance and transition risks.

  • Drive adoption of new ways of working across HR and Finance functions.

Vendor & Governance Management

  • Act as the primary programme interface with the outsourced service provider.

  • Meet regularly with the outsourced service provider programme director.

  • Ensure delivery against agreed transition milestones and service commitments.

  • Manage programme governance forums.

  • Actively manage and escalate programme risks, issues, and dependencies.

  • Support service readiness reviews and operational acceptance processes.

  • Ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory, security, and control requirements.

Operational Readiness & Stabilisation

  • Monitor service performance during stabilisation.

  • Support implementation of appropriate KPIs, SLAs, and operational controls.

  • Drive continuous improvement opportunities throughout transition and early operations.

Key Skills

  • Large-scale programme management

  • HR outsourcing transitions

  • Finance outsourcing transitions

  • Hub and spoke offshoring and shared services

  • Transformation delivery

  • Change management

  • Stakeholder management

  • Vendor governance

  • Service transition management

  • Risk and issue management

  • Commercial acumen

  • Executive communication

  • Business process improvement

  • Cross-functional leadership

  • Benefits realisation

  • Operational readiness

  • Continuous improvement

Candidate Requirements

Essential Experience

  • Proven experience delivering large-scale first-generation outsourcing programmes.

  • Direct experience transitioning HR and Finance services to India.

  • Experience managing third-party outsourcing partners through transition and stabilisation phases.

  • Strong programme and project management background in complex multinational organisations.

  • Experience leading organisational change and operating model transformation.

  • Experience managing executive stakeholders and steering committees.

  • Demonstrated success delivering complex business outsourcing projects/ programmes on time and within budget.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience with Workday and Oracle NetSuite

  • Experience working across multiple geographies and cultures.

  • Prior consulting or transformation office experience.


ISP Principles


Begin with our children and students. Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding

and Health & Safety issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.


Treat everyone with care and respect. We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well-being of self and others.


Operate effectively. We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.


Are financially responsible. We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.


Learn continuously. Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.

All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.

ISP Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.
